SQLite (+ FTS5) + ChromaDB + 70 migrations │ │ ├── pipeline/ # Event processing (ingest → route → stage → emit → trace → learn → context_learn → omni) │ │ ├── llm/ # LiteLLM client, agent inference backends, prompts, tools │ │ ├── agents/ # Coding agent adapters (Claude, Gemini, Codex, Pi, Cursor) │ │ ├── workers/ # Multi-persona LLM workers (engineer, comms, ops, sales, hr, finance) │ │ ├── egress/ # Outbound action execution (9 platforms) │ │ ├── integrations/ # n8n bootstrap & client │ │ └── security/ # OS keychain integration │ ├── requirements.txt # Core Python dependencies (version ranges) │ ├── requirements-ml.txt # Optional: torch + sentence-transformers │ └── requirements*.lock # Exact pinned versions that get installed │ ├── ui/ # SvelteKit + Tauri desktop app │ ├── src/ # Svelte 5 frontend (runes syntax) │ │ ├── routes/ # Pages (feed, coherence, dashboard, settings, workspace, omni) │ │ ├── lib/ # Components, API client, stores │ │ ├── app.css # Tailwind v4 + theme system │ │ └── app.html │ ├── src-tauri/ # Rust/Tauri shell │ │ ├── src/ │ │ │ ├── lib.rs # Tauri setup, commands, health polling, tray │ │ │ ├── sidecar.rs # Python venv lifecycle & engine spawning │ │ │ └── n8n.rs # n8n process management │ │ ├── tauri.conf.json # Tauri config (resources, icons, window) │ │ └── resources/ # Bundled engine source (production builds) │ ├── package.json │ └── svelte.config.js # Static adapter (SPA mode) │ ├── n8n/ │ └── workflows/ # Integration workflows (JSON, ~21 files: ingestion + executor per platform) │ ├── scripts/ │ ├── setup-dev.sh # One-time dev environment setup │ ├── dev.sh # Start engine + Tauri dev server │ ├── build.sh # Production build │ └── update_icons.sh # Icon generation │ ├── landing/ # Landing page └── docs/ # Architecture & design documents Install The fastest way to try Laya is a prebuilt release — no toolchains required. Open the Releases page and download the installer for your platform: Platform Download macOS .dmg (universal — Apple Silicon + Intel) Windows .msi or .exe Linux .deb or .AppImage Install and launch. You do not need Python, Node, or Rust installed to run a release build. On first run, Laya checks for a compatible Python (3.10–3.14; on Windows, an x64 build) and Node.js (20+) already on your machine and uses those if found; otherwise it provisions its own bundled runtimes. Either way, a local n8n instance is set up under ~/.laya/ . Add an API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, …) or point Laya at a local Ollama / LM Studio endpoint, then connect your tools from Settings. macOS: release builds are signed, so they open normally — just double-click to launch. Want to build from source, hack on the engine, or contribute? Follow the Development setup below. Development Prerequisites You need three runtimes installed. Here's how to get each one: Python 3.10+ macOS: brew install python@3.12 (or download from python.org ) Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install python3 python3-venv python3-pip Windows: Download from python.org (check "Add to PATH" during install) Verify: python3 --version Node.js 20+ All platforms: Download from nodejs.org (LTS recommended), or use a version manager like nvm / fnm macOS: brew install node Ubuntu/Debian: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt install -y nodejs Verify: node --version && npm --version Rust toolchain Install via rustup : curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh Verify: cargo --version Platform-specific dependencies macOS: xcode-select --install Linux (Ubuntu/Debian): Tauri v2 requires system libraries for GTK, WebKit, and app-indicator support: sudo apt install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf Troubleshooting Linux: Tailwind CSS classes missing or styles not updating The default Linux inotify file watcher limit (65,536) can be too low for this project -- Vite needs to watch the source files while the Rust target/ directory consumes most of the quota, causing Tailwind CSS to silently fail to generate utility classes. Increase the limit: # Immediate (resets on reboot) echo 524288 | sudo tee /proc/sys/fs/inotify/max_user_watches # Permanent echo 'fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288' | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.conf sudo sysctl -p Linux AppImage: blank white window, WebKitWebProcess aborts with EGL_BAD_PARAMETER On distros whose Mesa is built against libwayland 1.23 or newer (Arch/CachyOS, Fedora 44+, Ubuntu 25.04+ in some configurations), the AppImage may open a blank window and print: Could not create default EGL display: EGL_BAD_PARAMETER. Aborting... The AppImage bundles an old libwayland-client.so.0 (from the Ubuntu 22.04 build host) and forces it onto every process via LD_LIBRARY_PATH , while EGL/Mesa come from your system. Newer Mesa needs Wayland symbols the bundled copy lacks, so its EGL driver fails to load and WebKit aborts. WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER , GDK_BACKEND=x11 and similar variables do not help because the failure happens before any renderer is chosen. Workaround: extract the AppImage, delete the bundled Wayland libraries so the system copies are used, and run the extracted app: ./Laya_*_amd64.AppImage --appimage-extract mv squashfs-root ~/.local/share/laya-app # or anywhere permanent rm ~/.local/share/laya-app/usr/lib/libwayland-*.so.* ~/.local/share/laya-app/AppRun The .deb and .rpm packages use your system WebKitGTK and are not affected, so prefer them where they install cleanly. This is caused by the AppImage bundler Laya uses (Tauri pins an old linuxdeploy whose exclude list predates the upstream libwayland-client exclusion); see tauri-apps/tauri#15665 and tauri-apps/tauri#15976 , tracked for Laya in #17 . Linux setup: "Setting up automation" fails with EALLOWREMOTE (npm 12+) If ~/.laya/logs/n8n-install.log ends with: npm error code EALLOWREMOTE npm error Fetching packages of type "remote" have been disabled npm error Refusing to fetch "xlsx@https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.2/xlsx-0.20.2.tgz" your npm is version 12 or newer, which defaults allow-remote to none . n8n depends on n8n-nodes-base , which pins xlsx to a tarball hosted outside the npm registry, so npm refuses to install it. This happens when Laya finds a system Node 22+ whose npm was upgraded separately (for example Arch's npm package). Laya's managed Node download ships npm 10 and is unaffected. Laya passes --allow-remote=all on its n8n install starting with the release after v1.9.1. On v1.9.1 or earlier, install n8n by hand with a project-local .npmrc so your global npm settings stay untouched, then click Retry in the setup screen: mkdir -p ~/.laya/n8n_module printf 'allow-remote=all\n' > ~/.laya/n8n_module/.npmrc npm install --prefix ~/.laya/n8n_module n8n@2.15.0 allow-remote=root is not enough because xlsx is a transitive dependency. Tracked in #18 . Windows (incl. Windows on ARM): setup fails with "Wheels are required for aiohttp " / tiktoken / chromadb If the "Installing Python packages" step fails and %USERPROFILE%\.laya\logs\pip-install.log contains a line like: hint: Wheels are required for `aiohttp` because building from source is disabled for all packages (i.e., with `--no-build`) Laya picked up a Python from your PATH that it can't install its dependencies into. Laya installs only prebuilt wheels (it never compiles packages), and two kinds of interpreter have no wheels for some of its dependencies: Python newer than 3.14 (e.g. 3.15): aiohttp , torch and others haven't published wheels for it yet. This affects every platform. Native ARM64 Python on Windows ( win-arm64 ), any version: chromadb , tiktoken , litellm (via fastuuid ), grpcio and torch publish no Windows-on-ARM wheels. The Windows release of Laya is an x64 app, which Windows on ARM runs under emulation, so it works with an x64 Python. Releases after v1.9.2 skip these interpreters automatically. They download Laya's own x64 Python 3.12 instead and rebuild a venv that was created with the wrong interpreter. On v1.9.2 or earlier, quit Laya and point it at a compatible Python yourself, using either option below. Then relaunch Laya. Setup rebuilds the venv, which takes a few minutes. Option A (recommended): pre-install Laya's managed Python. Laya prefers %USERPROFILE%\.laya\python over anything on PATH , so this works regardless of which other Pythons you have. In PowerShell: $laya = "$env:USERPROFILE\.laya" Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$laya\venv", "$laya\.deps_hash", "$laya\python" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $laya | Out-Null $tag = "20260510"; $ver = "3.12.13" $url = "https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download/$tag/cpython-$ver+$tag-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-install_only.tar.gz" Invoke-WebRequest $url -OutFile "$env:TEMP\laya-python.tar.gz" tar -xzf "$env:TEMP\laya-python.tar.gz" -C $laya # creates .laya\python Set-Content "$laya\python\.version" $ver -NoNewline Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\laya-python.tar.gz" Option B: install an x64 Python 3.12 or 3.13 and put it first on PATH . Download the "Windows installer (64-bit)" , not the ARM64 one, from python.org and tick "Add python.exe to PATH". Then make sure python --version in a new terminal reports that version. Run python -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_platform())" to confirm it prints win-amd64 . Finally, delete %USERPROFILE%\.laya\venv and %USERPROFILE%\.laya\.deps_hash . pip install laya is not a way to install this app. The laya package on PyPI is an unrelated project that requires torch . Use the installers on the Releases page . Tracked in #14 . Linux: Tauri build fails with unable to find library -lssl / -lcrypto The Rust shell is rustls-only and should not need system OpenSSL, which is why libssl-dev is not in the apt list above. If the linker asks for -lssl / -lcrypto , a dependency has pulled in native-tls (→ openssl-sys ) again -- usually a reqwest declared without default-features = false . Find the culprit with: cd ui/src-tauri && cargo tree -i openssl-sys and fix the offending dependency's features. As a stop-gap, sudo apt install libssl-dev lets the build link as-is. Setup scripts/setup-dev.sh This script does the following: Checks that python3 , node , npm , and cargo are available Creates a Python virtual environment at engine/.venv/ and installs dependencies from engine/requirements.txt Installs npm packages for the UI ( ui/node_modules/ ) Installs n8n as a local npm package into ~/.laya/n8n_module/ Creates data directories at ~/.laya/data/ and ~/.laya/logs/ Running Locally scripts/dev.sh This starts two processes: Python engine -- python -m laya.main (with hot reload) at http://127.0.0.1:8420 Tauri dev server -- npx @tauri-apps/cli dev which starts Vite at http://localhost:5173 and opens the Tauri window n8n is managed automatically by the Tauri app -- it starts on launch (port 45678) and stops on quit. Note: If the engine fails with "Address already in use", a stale engine process may be holding port 8420. The engine will attempt to kill it automatically on startup. Configuration On first launch, the engine creates config files in ~/.laya/ : File Purpose settings.json Models, agent paths, privacy settings, pipeline params team.json Team member context rules.json Event filtering rules repos.json Git repository paths and metadata API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, etc.) are stored securely in your OS keychain and can be configured through the Settings UI. The engine logs at INFO by default. Change verbosity from Settings → Data → Engine Log Level ( DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR ) — this maps to the logging.level key in settings.json and applies immediately, no restart. Set it to WARNING to record only warnings and errors and keep logs small. For a single run you can override it with the LAYA_LOG_LEVEL environment variable, which takes precedence over the setting (and also sets uvicorn's request-log level). Custom Prompts Laya's AI pipeline uses system prompts at every stage (routing, staging, summarization, chat, etc.). All prompts ship with sensible defaults, but you can override any of them by placing files in ~/.laya/prompts/ : mkdir -p ~/.laya/prompts # Override the router prompt (controls event classification) vim ~/.laya/prompts/router.md # Override a worker persona vim ~/.laya/prompts/engineer.md # Reload without restarting curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8420/prompts/reload Available prompt files: router.md , stager.md , omni.md , group_summary_initial.md , group_summary_rolling.md , briefing.md , summarizer.md , summarizer_status_change.md , engineer.md , comms.md , sales.md , hr.md , ops.md , finance.md , chat.md , chat_title.md , chat_polish.md , learner.md , context_learner.md , trace_narrative.md , trace_summary.md , trace_filter.md . Custom prompts fully replace the built-in default for that stage. If a file is deleted, the hardcoded default is used automatically. The engine never creates or modifies files in this directory. Use GET /prompts to check which prompts are currently overridden. Data Storage Store Location Purpose SQLite ~/.laya/data/laya.db Events, cards, workspaces, spaces, traces, egress, chat ChromaDB ~/.laya/data/chroma/ Vector embeddings for semantic search n8n ~/.laya/n8n/ Workflow data, credentials (encrypted) Logs ~/.laya/logs/ engine.log — rotating engine logs (10 MB × 5 files), verbosity set by the log level above. Also engine-stdout.log and n8n.log — captured process output, likewise rotated (10 MB × 3 files). Building for Distribution Laya bundles the Python engine source into the Tauri app. On first launch, the app creates a Python virtual environment at ~/.laya/venv/ and installs dependencies automatically -- no Python installation is required on the end user's machine beyond what the app manages. Build Command scripts/build.sh This does two things: Bundles engine source -- copies engine/laya/ , the requirements files and their lock files, and n8n/workflows/ into ui/src-tauri/resources/engine/ Builds the Tauri app -- compiles the Rust shell, bundles the SvelteKit frontend, and packages everything into a platform-native installer Build Options scripts/build.sh # Build for current platform scripts/build.sh --target x86_64-apple-darwin # Cross-compile for Intel Mac scripts/build.sh --universal # Universal binary (arm64 + x86_64) scripts/build.sh --sign "Developer ID App: ..." # macOS code signing scripts/build.sh --skip-engine # Skip engine bundling (reuse previous) Build Output Platform Format Path macOS .app ui/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Laya.app macOS .dmg ui/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/Laya_0.1.0_<arch>.dmg Windows .msi ui/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/msi/ Windows .exe ui/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis/ Linux .deb ui/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/deb/ Linux AppImage ui/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/ Note: macOS builds are unsigned by default. Unsigned apps trigger Gatekeeper -- users must right-click > Open to bypass. Pass --sign with an Apple Developer identity to produce a signed build. Documentation Architecture and design documents in docs/ : System Architecture -- Component diagrams and service descriptions Event Schema -- The Laya Event schema specification API Contracts -- REST, WebSocket, and inter-service API definitions Database Schema -- SQLite tables (incl. FTS5), ChromaDB collection, and migrations Project Structure -- Repository layout and config file schemas Tuning Parameters -- Overridable pipeline, retrieval, and agent-budget settings n8n Data Persistence -- How n8n workflow data and credentials are stored Decision Log -- Architectural decisions with rationale Deeper design docs (egress, AI processing rules, OAuth app distribution, pipeline lifecycle) live in engine/docs/ .

items.title: superdesigndev/treg
items.description: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn https://treg.to Treg (OpenRouter for Tools) OpenRouter, but for agent tools instead of models. Point an agent at one base URL with one token and it can do the job: a curated catalog of thousands of endpoints across many providers — SEO and backlinks, social and trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping, image and video generation — priced per call, from a cent, with no provider signup. Plus your own team's keys, skills and CLIs, callable by every teammate's agent without the credential ever leaving the server. Ask for the task, not the tool. You do not need to know which vendor sells backlink data, or to hold an account with them. Search for what you want to do, read the price, call it. Built for the Superdesign team, live at treg.to — anyone can self-host. Why it exists The tools an agent needs for real work sit behind subscriptions nobody buys for a single run — Semrush $139/mo, Moz $99/mo, Crunchbase $99/mo, Apollo $59/seat — behind signup walls, or behind no public API at all (invite-only, partner-only, app-review-only). treg carries those accounts and bills fractions of a cent per call. Two kinds of tool, one token The catalog — external endpoints treg can serve with its own key or through a verified public route that needs no provider key. Own-key calls use the team's prepaid balance; anonymous calls are free. No account with the provider is needed. New verified accounts receive $1.00 free once, when they create an eligible team. Your own tools — anything a teammate registered: a paid API account, an OAuth connection, a vendor CLI, a SKILL.md. Your own key always wins over treg's, and those calls are never metered. The vocabulary for the second half: tool = something the registry calls for you with the org's credential. Two kinds: endpoint — an upstream base_url + credential bindings (each binding injects one secret into the request; a request can carry several, e.g. an OAuth bearer and a developer-token header). CLI — a vendor binary (stripe, gh, vercel, ...) run with the credential injected. skill / bundle = a recipe (SKILL.md) + its secrets + its tool(s), registered together. The one rule: the proxy relays, never models the upstream, and injects auth server-side — so it survives upstream API changes and callers never hold keys. Part 1 · Using the registry Visit treg.to (hosted on Render) — the dashboard, sign-in, and every URL below live there. Quickstart Same flow as the dashboard's Getting started guide: # 1. install the CLI — also points it at the registry curl -fsSL https://treg.to/install.sh | sh # 2. sign in (GitHub default · --email for a one-time code · --token for agents/CI) treg login # 3. do something useful immediately — no key, nothing registered treg catalog search "backlinks for a domain" # find a tool by what it DOES treg call tikhub.tiktok.user.profile --query uniqueId=tiktok treg balance # exactly what that cost # (or `treg onboard` for the guided walkthrough) Fish Audio provides S2.1 Pro speech, public-voice discovery, and private voice cloning. Speech is binary stdout, so redirect it to a file. A discovered voice's _id or a team voice id is the TTS reference_id; voices created on treg's Fish account are durable team resources: treg call fishaudio.tts.s2-1-pro --method POST --header model=s2.1-pro \ --data '{"text":"Hello from treg","format":"mp3"}' > speech.mp3 treg call fishaudio.voices.discover --query self=false --query licensed=false --query language=en treg resources list --provider fishaudio --kind voice With your own Fish key, requests remain an unrestricted, unmetered upstream relay and Fish owns the account boundary. Catalog tool inputs are described by treg catalog get . Tools marked strict_query reject undeclared or repeated query parameters, unsupported values and request bodies. Your token identifies you on every call (X-Treg-Token header) and is the same for all tools. Discover what your team has shared: treg tool ls · check credential health: treg health. Or install it as a Claude Code plugin /plugin marketplace add superdesigndev/treg /plugin install treg@treg Installs with no token and no configuration. The skill loads as treg:treg and, on its first run, walks your agent through the rest — the CLI, sign-in, then treg mcp install — so you end up with the command line and treg's tools. Other agents: npx skills add superdesigndev/treg -s treg (or see Workflow skills for the rest). See docs/CLAUDE-PLUGIN.md. MiniMax Code / MiniMax Agent users: the same skill ships via the MiniMax Plugin Marketplace (docs/MINIMAX-PLUGIN.md). Workflow skills Ready-made recipes your agent runs end to end, every call through treg: Skill What your agent can do treg Find and call any tool in the catalog, plus your own tools lead-signals Find in-market buyers from public signals (complaints, job changes, hiring, funding, tool adoption) and monitor a topic, competitor or account list for them (treg.to/leads-signals) make-ugc Make AI UGC videos: trending hooks, a presenter, talking-head clips, captions (treg.to/ugc) install.sh installs all of them for you. To add them to an existing agent instead (skills.sh CLI): npx skills add superdesigndev/treg # every public skill npx skills add superdesigndev/treg --skill lead-signals # just one treg skill bootstrap # same set, with the treg CLI you already have The workflow skills run on treg, so set it up first (the Quickstart above, or point your agent at treg.to/llms.txt). Claude.ai connector The Claude Connectors Directory surface is https://treg.to/mcp/v2/. It exposes only curated catalog endpoints and separates read calls from write calls so Claude receives accurate safety signals. The existing /mcp/ surface remains available for catalog endpoints, team-owned tools, and imported skills. See the MCP and OAuth architecture for the boundary and implementation, and the submission runbook for release gates. Call a tool you don't have a key for The catalog is grouped by what endpoints do: keyword and rank tracking, backlinks and authority, AI visibility, trending and discovery, publishing to socials, people and company enrichment, ads management and creative, measurement. treg catalog # every platform, busiest first treg catalog search "find a work email" # by the job, not the vendor treg catalog get hunter.people.email.find # params, PRICE, example response treg call hunter.people.email.find --query domain=reddit.com --query full_name="Alexis Ohanian" How a catalogued call is served — the credential ladder, in order: your team registered its own tool for that provider → that tool, that key; your team stored a secret for the provider → injected through a virtual tool; neither, and the endpoint has a verified public route → no provider key, free; otherwise → treg's own key, billed to the team's prepaid balance. The anonymous price assumes the caller does not send a provider credential header. The faithful relay preserves caller headers, so a caller-supplied provider key can use that key's credits. Your own credential always beats treg's, so connecting a key you already pay for makes those calls free of the balance rather than duplicating them. An endpoint treg has no published price for is refused, not served free — you are told to connect your own key instead. Where several providers serve one capability, treg catalog search shows them side by side with prices; choosing is yours — treg does not silently pick or fail over between providers for you. (When treg's own account for a provider is out it may serve the same endpoint through a treg-owned relay account, disclosed on the response; a team can opt out.) The exception you opt into: treg. routed endpoints, where treg picks the provider for you and names it. treg balance # credit left, calls in flight, recent spend treg topup # add funds, or set up automatic top-ups Out of balance is an HTTP 402 carrying balance_micro, estimated_cost_micro and a topup_url, so an agent can act on it without reading prose. Enrich Arena lives at /enrich-arena, outside the dashboard. Compare enrichment answers with each vendor’s cost and speed, vote for the best answer in one click, or watch a sequential waterfall. Capability-compatible async providers participate too; Arena handles submit and polling internally. Browsing is public; submitting requires login, and billable attempts use your team's credits. See the Arena guide. Share & use your own tools The zero-thought path — point treg at a project and it figures out what's shareable: treg scan # read-only preview: the keys, skills & CLIs upload would register treg upload # register them (encrypted server-side); idempotent, --replace to update treg upload scans the .env (matching keys against ~80 known providers), every skill subdirectory, and installed catalog CLIs. Three kinds of things go into the registry — here's how to share and use each: 1. Endpoints (HTTP APIs) Share — one upstream URL callable with a stored key, or bulk from a .env: treg secret add STRIPE_KEY --value sk_live_123 treg add stripe --base-url https://api.stripe.com --secret STRIPE_KEY treg upload env --select openai,stripe,resend # or straight from the .env Use — the agent-native way: build the real upstream request and prefix it with the proxy. treg resolves the tool by host, injects the credential, and relays everything else faithfully (your X-Treg-Token is stripped before the upstream sees it): Real request: GET https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5 Through treg: GET https://treg.to/call/https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5 header: X-Treg-Token: Or the CLI shorthand — and treg calls for the audit log: treg call intercom conversations --query per_page=5 treg call stripe v1/balance 2. CLIs Share — automatic: treg upload detects installed catalog CLIs (stripe, gh, vercel, …) and registers them; a recipe-only catalog CLI skill (e.g. stripe-cli) auto-becomes runnable too. Use — treg run executes the vendor CLI with the org's credential injected, so you never hold the key or log in: treg run stripe -- get /v1/balance treg run gh -- pr list treg run --server agentmail-cli inboxes list # runs on the registry server: the key never reaches you --local (default) runs on your machine; --server runs on the registry and streams output back. For a whole session, treg shell start opens a subshell where every registered CLI injects automatically — just use stripe, gh, … normally; exit reverts. treg runs is the audit log. 3. Skills Share — a skill is a whole capability (SKILL.md recipe + its secrets + its tool(s)), registered together so the whole team runs the same skill, maintained in one place: treg upload skills --dir ~/.claude/skills --all # register a folder of skills in one pass Use — pull any shared skill into your agent; its API calls go through treg with your token, so the key stays on the server, never in the skill: treg skill install seo-blog-writer # writes into ./.claude/skills/ (--all for the library) Manual registration — when the heuristics can't figure a tool out # multi-credential tool (e.g. google-ads: OAuth bearer + a developer-token header) treg tool add google-ads --base-url https://googleads.googleapis.com \ --bind "secret= ,injector=oauth" \ --bind "secret= ,name=developer-token,format={secret}" # one skill, step by step treg skill init --dir ./my-skill # drafts treg.json (guesses base_url, finds secrets) treg skill add --dir ./my-skill # registers recipe + secrets + tool, atomically # OAuth via the browser (mints the first token, treg holds it and auto-refreshes) treg oauth connect gsc --client-secret client_secret.json \ --scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly Full options for every command: USAGE.md. The CLI sends anonymous command usage to PostHog when using treg.to (no arguments or credentials). Disable with TREG_TELEMETRY=0 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1. See analytics details. Teams An account can own up to 10 teams. Joining other teams as a member does not count toward this limit. Everything is scoped to an org: a token = a (user, org) membership, and every secret, tool, and skill belongs to the active org. Roles: owner / admin / member / viewer. treg org create "Acme" # make a team, become owner treg org invite teammate@acme.com # invite by email (pick role + tool access) treg org join --email you@acme.com # accept an invite (creates you if new) treg org ls | use | members # switch orgs, see the roster treg org access --tools a,b # per-member tool access (admin+) Going deeper Feedback: treg feedback submit friction "The pagination example is unclear." Share problems or suggestions without private information. See feedback instructions. Review: treg review CALL_ID useful Rate an invited catalog call after using its result; not_sure is fine. Requires callers to opt in; existing queries are unchanged. See read datasource setup. TREG_SECRET_KEY (empty) Fernet key for secrets-at-rest; empty → an ephemeral key is minted (secrets won't survive a restart) TREG_PUBLIC_URL https://treg.to treg's public base, used to build the OAuth callback URI TREG_SESSION_SECRET (empty) signs the dashboard session cookie; falls back to TREG_SECRET_KEY. Set a real value in prod TREG_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET (empty) GitHub OAuth sign-in (callback /auth/github/callback); empty hides the button TREG_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET (empty) Google OAuth sign-in (redirect /auth/google/callback); empty hides the button TREG_INSTAGRAM_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET (empty) Instagram App ID and secret for direct Instagram Login (redirect /oauth/callback) TREG_META_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET (empty) Meta app credentials for Facebook Pages, Meta Ads, and optional Instagram page-tools TREG_OAUTH_REVIEW_PENDING instagram-login,page-messages Comma-separated registry review keys whose capabilities must remain gated; hosted review state is maintained privately. TREG_RESEND_API_KEY / TREG_EMAIL_FROM (empty) transactional email via Resend (OTP codes + invites); From must be a Resend-verified sender TREG_BLOCKED_EMAIL_DOMAINS (empty) comma-separated email domains refused at every sign-up/sign-in door and at team creation (subdomains included, case-insensitive). Empty blocks nothing — no list ships in the code TREG_ADMIN_TOKEN (empty) cross-tenant super-admin bearer; authorizes every /admin/* endpoint. Empty disables the env path (only is_superadmin users reach /admin). Keep it long + secret. TREG_EMAIL_DEV_MODE false when true, /auth/email/start returns the OTP in its response (no mail sender needed) — dev/local only, never in prod. TREG_KV_URL (empty) shared key-value store (Redis protocol) for counters every worker must agree on, today the per-team review-invitation budget. Empty = an in-process fallback, fine for one worker No .env is needed for local dev — every setting has a working default (ephemeral key, sqlite). ⚠️ Back these up before moving or redeploying: the Fernet key (TREG_SECRET_KEY) and the database (Postgres in prod; treg.db for a local sqlite run). Lose the Fernet key and every stored secret becomes unrecoverable. Architecture Request flow for /call: resolve tool (by URL host + longest base_url prefix, or by name) → decrypt its secret(s) → apply each binding's injector → stream to the upstream → fire-and-forget audit record. The infra relay streams bytes without business logic. The call application buffers responses needing settlement or ownership evidence up to 8 MiB; larger responses return a 502 without charging instead of a truncated success. Endpoints that inline media (Gemini images) declare spooled_response: their metered answer is read to a temp file instead, settled from its reported usage, and relayed whole. Authorized free final downloads needing no body evidence stream in full, as do own-key and own-tool responses. Module map (src/treg/): Module Role proxy.py relay() — the whole product in one function: a faithful streaming proxy injectors.py the auth-shape seam: env, cli_auth, secret_file, oauth place a secret into a header/query oauth.py token freshness (single-flight refresh) + the connect flow (consent URL, code exchange) health.py credential health: refresh oauth, probe tools, webhook the owner of anything broken convert.py scaffold a skill directory into a registerable bundle manifest api.py the API — the only brain; CLI + skill are thin clients over it cli.py the treg CLI models.py SQLModel tables: Org, User, Membership, Invite, Secret, Tool, Bundle, PendingOAuth, CallRecord crypto.py config.py db.py audit.py Fernet encryption + tokens · settings · async DB · deferred audit writer The 4 auth shapes (per binding injector): env (plain string / API key) · secret_file (a JSON token file, pull a field) · oauth (a JSON OAuth token, auto-refreshed if refreshable) · cli_auth (material lifted from a CLI's keychain). Health checks: give a tool an optional probe ({method, path, expect_status}); a periodic run (on demand or via cron) validates every credential, refreshes OAuth, and webhooks the owner of any that break. Deep design lives in docs/context/ (per-subsystem fragments). Tests uv run --with pytest-xdist pytest -n auto -q # daily local default (same shape as CI) uv run --frozen python -m pytest -q # serial: debugging one test, or order Coverage: proxy walking-skeleton, all injector shapes, per-user auth + CRUD + audit, skill composer, URL-passthrough + faithful relay, OAuth refresh + connect flow, health checks, treg run/shell, upload/scan, orgs + invites, the dashboard API, CLI. Working in this repo with an AI agent? The /tools-registry-context skill loads the right fragment for what you're touching and keeps the docs in sync — run /tools-registry-context sync before pushing. Roadmap: MCP support · finer permission tiers · at-rest key-management hardening · possible Loopni merge. License Apache 2.0 with additional terms (LICENSE): use it freely — including commercially, inside your own organization (self-hosting your own registry is encouraged). The restriction: don't redistribute the code to third parties as a competing hosted/managed registry service without written permission (jason@superdesign.dev). Using the hosted treg.to API inside your own product — with pass-through billing via X-Treg-Meta and usage/by-tag — is allowed without permission; that's calling our API, not redistributing our software. Pinned customer read scopes For a restricted customer agent, treg org agent-new bot --pin customer=cust_A enforces attribution and scopes call/run history, archived results and shared-provider async ownership to that pin. Foreign or unattributed ids return 404; an unpinned operator keeps the org-wide view and shared balance. BYOK account access and public media URLs retain their existing permissions. items.content: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn https://treg.to Treg (OpenRouter for Tools) OpenRouter, but for agent tools instead of models. Point an agent at one base URL with one token and it can do the job: a curated catalog of thousands of endpoints across many providers — SEO and backlinks, social and trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping, image and video generation — priced per call, from a cent , with no provider signup. Plus your own team's keys, skills and CLIs, callable by every teammate's agent without the credential ever leaving the server. Ask for the task, not the tool. You do not need to know which vendor sells backlink data, or to hold an account with them. Search for what you want to do, read the price, call it. Built for the Superdesign team, live at treg.to — anyone can self-host. Why it exists The tools an agent needs for real work sit behind subscriptions nobody buys for a single run — Semrush $139/mo, Moz $99/mo, Crunchbase $99/mo, Apollo $59/seat — behind signup walls, or behind no public API at all (invite-only, partner-only, app-review-only). treg carries those accounts and bills fractions of a cent per call. Two kinds of tool, one token The catalog — external endpoints treg can serve with its own key or through a verified public route that needs no provider key. Own-key calls use the team's prepaid balance; anonymous calls are free. No account with the provider is needed. New verified accounts receive $1.00 free once, when they create an eligible team. Your own tools — anything a teammate registered: a paid API account, an OAuth connection, a vendor CLI, a SKILL.md . Your own key always wins over treg's, and those calls are never metered. The vocabulary for the second half: tool = something the registry calls for you with the org's credential. Two kinds: endpoint — an upstream base_url + credential bindings (each binding injects one secret into the request; a request can carry several, e.g. an OAuth bearer and a developer-token header). CLI — a vendor binary ( stripe , gh , vercel , ...) run with the credential injected. skill / bundle = a recipe ( SKILL.md ) + its secrets + its tool(s), registered together. The one rule: the proxy relays, never models the upstream, and injects auth server-side — so it survives upstream API changes and callers never hold keys. Part 1 · Using the registry Visit treg.to (hosted on Render) — the dashboard, sign-in, and every URL below live there. Quickstart Same flow as the dashboard's Getting started guide: # 1. install the CLI — also points it at the registry curl -fsSL https://treg.to/install.sh | sh # 2. sign in (GitHub default · --email for a one-time code · --token for agents/CI) treg login # 3. do something useful immediately — no key, nothing registered treg catalog search "backlinks for a domain" # find a tool by what it DOES treg call tikhub.tiktok.user.profile --query uniqueId=tiktok treg balance # exactly what that cost # (or `treg onboard` for the guided walkthrough) Fish Audio provides S2.1 Pro speech, public-voice discovery, and private voice cloning. Speech is binary stdout, so redirect it to a file. A discovered voice's _id or a team voice id is the TTS reference_id ; voices created on treg's Fish account are durable team resources: treg call fishaudio.tts.s2-1-pro --method POST --header model=s2.1-pro \ --data '{"text":"Hello from treg","format":"mp3"}' > speech.mp3 treg call fishaudio.voices.discover --query self=false --query licensed=false --query language=en treg resources list --provider fishaudio --kind voice With your own Fish key, requests remain an unrestricted, unmetered upstream relay and Fish owns the account boundary. Catalog tool inputs are described by treg catalog get <id> . Tools marked strict_query reject undeclared or repeated query parameters, unsupported values and request bodies. Your token identifies you on every call ( X-Treg-Token header) and is the same for all tools. Discover what your team has shared: treg tool ls · check credential health: treg health . Or install it as a Claude Code plugin /plugin marketplace add superdesigndev/treg /plugin install treg@treg Installs with no token and no configuration. The skill loads as treg:treg and, on its first run, walks your agent through the rest — the CLI, sign-in, then treg mcp install — so you end up with the command line and treg's tools. Other agents: npx skills add superdesigndev/treg -s treg (or see Workflow skills for the rest). See docs/CLAUDE-PLUGIN.md . MiniMax Code / MiniMax Agent users: the same skill ships via the MiniMax Plugin Marketplace ( docs/MINIMAX-PLUGIN.md ). Workflow skills Ready-made recipes your agent runs end to end, every call through treg: Skill What your agent can do treg Find and call any tool in the catalog, plus your own tools lead-signals Find in-market buyers from public signals (complaints, job changes, hiring, funding, tool adoption) and monitor a topic, competitor or account list for them ( treg.to/leads-signals ) make-ugc Make AI UGC videos: trending hooks, a presenter, talking-head clips, captions ( treg.to/ugc ) install.sh installs all of them for you. To add them to an existing agent instead ( skills.sh CLI): npx skills add superdesigndev/treg # every public skill npx skills add superdesigndev/treg --skill lead-signals # just one treg skill bootstrap # same set, with the treg CLI you already have The workflow skills run on treg, so set it up first (the Quickstart above, or point your agent at treg.to/llms.txt ). Claude.ai connector The Claude Connectors Directory surface is https://treg.to/mcp/v2/ . It exposes only curated catalog endpoints and separates read calls from write calls so Claude receives accurate safety signals. The existing /mcp/ surface remains available for catalog endpoints, team-owned tools, and imported skills. See the MCP and OAuth architecture for the boundary and implementation, and the submission runbook for release gates. Call a tool you don't have a key for The catalog is grouped by what endpoints do : keyword and rank tracking, backlinks and authority, AI visibility, trending and discovery, publishing to socials, people and company enrichment, ads management and creative, measurement. treg catalog # every platform, busiest first treg catalog search "find a work email" # by the job, not the vendor treg catalog get hunter.people.email.find # params, PRICE, example response treg call hunter.people.email.find --query domain=reddit.com --query full_name="Alexis Ohanian" How a catalogued call is served — the credential ladder, in order: your team registered its own tool for that provider → that tool, that key; your team stored a secret for the provider → injected through a virtual tool; neither, and the endpoint has a verified public route → no provider key , free; otherwise → treg's own key , billed to the team's prepaid balance. The anonymous price assumes the caller does not send a provider credential header. The faithful relay preserves caller headers, so a caller-supplied provider key can use that key's credits. Your own credential always beats treg's, so connecting a key you already pay for makes those calls free of the balance rather than duplicating them. An endpoint treg has no published price for is refused , not served free — you are told to connect your own key instead. Where several providers serve one capability, treg catalog search shows them side by side with prices; choosing is yours — treg does not silently pick or fail over between providers for you. (When treg's own account for a provider is out it may serve the same endpoint through a treg-owned relay account, disclosed on the response; a team can opt out.) The exception you opt into: treg.<capability> routed endpoints, where treg picks the provider for you and names it. treg balance # credit left, calls in flight, recent spend treg topup # add funds, or set up automatic top-ups Out of balance is an HTTP 402 carrying balance_micro , estimated_cost_micro and a topup_url , so an agent can act on it without reading prose. Enrich Arena lives at /enrich-arena , outside the dashboard. Compare enrichment answers with each vendor’s cost and speed, vote for the best answer in one click, or watch a sequential waterfall. Capability-compatible async providers participate too; Arena handles submit and polling internally. Browsing is public; submitting requires login, and billable attempts use your team's credits. See the Arena guide . Share & use your own tools The zero-thought path — point treg at a project and it figures out what's shareable: treg scan # read-only preview: the keys, skills & CLIs upload would register treg upload # register them (encrypted server-side); idempotent, --replace to update treg upload scans the .env (matching keys against ~80 known providers), every skill subdirectory, and installed catalog CLIs. Three kinds of things go into the registry — here's how to share and use each: 1. Endpoints (HTTP APIs) Share — one upstream URL callable with a stored key, or bulk from a .env : treg secret add STRIPE_KEY --value sk_live_123 treg add stripe --base-url https://api.stripe.com --secret STRIPE_KEY treg upload env --select openai,stripe,resend # or straight from the .env Use — the agent-native way: build the real upstream request and prefix it with the proxy. treg resolves the tool by host, injects the credential, and relays everything else faithfully (your X-Treg-Token is stripped before the upstream sees it): Real request: GET https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5 Through treg: GET https://treg.to/call/https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5 header: X-Treg-Token: <your token> Or the CLI shorthand — and treg calls for the audit log: treg call intercom conversations --query per_page=5 treg call stripe v1/balance 2. CLIs Share — automatic: treg upload detects installed catalog CLIs ( stripe , gh , vercel , …) and registers them; a recipe-only catalog CLI skill (e.g. stripe-cli ) auto-becomes runnable too. Use — treg run executes the vendor CLI with the org's credential injected , so you never hold the key or log in: treg run stripe -- get /v1/balance treg run gh -- pr list treg run --server agentmail-cli inboxes list # runs on the registry server: the key never reaches you --local (default) runs on your machine; --server runs on the registry and streams output back. For a whole session, treg shell start opens a subshell where every registered CLI injects automatically — just use stripe , gh , … normally; exit reverts. treg runs is the audit log. 3. Skills Share — a skill is a whole capability ( SKILL.md recipe + its secrets + its tool(s)), registered together so the whole team runs the same skill, maintained in one place: treg upload skills --dir ~/.claude/skills --all # register a folder of skills in one pass Use — pull any shared skill into your agent; its API calls go through treg with your token, so the key stays on the server, never in the skill: treg skill install seo-blog-writer # writes into ./.claude/skills/ (--all for the library) Manual registration — when the heuristics can't figure a tool out # multi-credential tool (e.g. google-ads: OAuth bearer + a developer-token header) treg tool add google-ads --base-url https://googleads.googleapis.com \ --bind "secret=<oauth-id>,injector=oauth" \ --bind "secret=<dev-id>,name=developer-token,format={secret}" # one skill, step by step treg skill init --dir ./my-skill # drafts treg.json (guesses base_url, finds secrets) treg skill add --dir ./my-skill # registers recipe + secrets + tool, atomically # OAuth via the browser (mints the first token, treg holds it and auto-refreshes) treg oauth connect gsc --client-secret client_secret.json \ --scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly Full options for every command: USAGE.md . The CLI sends anonymous command usage to PostHog when using treg.to (no arguments or credentials). Disable with TREG_TELEMETRY=0 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 . See analytics details . Teams An account can own up to 10 teams. Joining other teams as a member does not count toward this limit. Everything is scoped to an org : a token = a (user, org) membership, and every secret, tool, and skill belongs to the active org. Roles: owner / admin / member / viewer . treg org create "Acme" # make a team, become owner treg org invite teammate@acme.com # invite by email (pick role + tool access) treg org join <code> --email you@acme.com # accept an invite (creates you if new) treg org ls | use <slug> | members # switch orgs, see the roster treg org access <member> --tools a,b # per-member tool access (admin+) Going deeper Feedback: treg feedback submit friction "The pagination example is unclear." Working in this repo with an AI agent? The /tools-registry-context skill loads the right fragment for what you're touching and keeps the docs in sync — run /tools-registry-context sync before pushing. Roadmap: MCP support · finer permission tiers · at-rest key-management hardening · possible Loopni merge. License Apache 2.0 with additional terms ( LICENSE ): use it freely — including commercially, inside your own organization (self-hosting your own registry is encouraged). The restriction: don't redistribute the code to third parties as a competing hosted/managed registry service without written permission ( jason@superdesign.dev ). Using the hosted treg.to API inside your own product — with pass-through billing via X-Treg-Meta and usage/by-tag — is allowed without permission; that's calling our API, not redistributing our software. Pinned customer read scopes For a restricted customer agent, treg org agent-new bot --pin customer=cust_A enforces attribution and scopes call/run history, archived results and shared-provider async ownership to that pin. Foreign or unattributed ids return 404; an unpinned operator keeps the org-wide view and shared balance. BYOK account access and public media URLs retain their existing permissions. See the multi-tenancy contract for multiple pins, migration and replay behavior.

items.title: strands-agents/harness-sdk
items.description: Build an agent harness and control it end-to-end. Open-source SDK for production AI agents in Python & TypeScript - any model, any cloud. http://strandsagents.com/ Strands Agents A model-driven approach to building AI agents in just a few lines of code. Documentation ◆ Samples ◆ MCP Server ◆ Discord Strands Agents is an open-source SDK for building and running AI agents in Python and TypeScript. Choose Strands when you would otherwise write your own agent loop: it runs in your process with no hosted control plane, and it covers the jobs a hand-rolled loop grows into. In one SDK you get lifecycle controls (turn limits, token budgets, cancellation, stop reasons), tools and structured output, MCP, multi-agent patterns, memory and sessions, model portability, streaming, guardrails, tracing, and evals. This monorepo contains Strands harness, the Python and TypeScript SDKs, the documentation site, and supporting packages: Directory Description harness-py/ Python Strands harness: fully assembled agent via create_harness() (PyPI · docs) harness-ts/ TypeScript Strands harness: fully assembled agent via createHarness() (npm · docs) strands-cli/ strands CLI: prototype and chat with a harness agent from the terminal (npm) strands-py/ Python SDK: agent loop, model providers, tools (PyPI · releases) strands-ts/ TypeScript SDK: agent loop, model providers, tools (npm · releases) site/ Source for the strandsagents.com documentation site (Astro/Starlight) team/ Governance and cross-SDK process docs (tenets, decisions, PR & compatibility guidelines, and designs/ proposals) Why Strands Build an agent harness. Control it end-to-end. Build your way. Any model, any cloud. Context management, execution limits, and observability built in before you write a line of config. Swap backends when you scale; your code stays the same. Model agnostic. First-class support for Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini, plus many more providers and custom ones. Stay in control. The agent loop traces every decision by default. Hooks let you intercept any step to log it, validate it, or redirect it. Deliver outcomes that work. Guardrails catch mistakes before they run. Steering handlers let agents correct themselves instead of failing silently. MCP, streaming, multi-agent patterns, and structured output are all built in. Quick Start The easiest way to get started is with Strands harness, a fully assembled, state-of-the-art agent. A single create_harness() (Python) or createHarness() (TypeScript) call gives you an optimized agent with benchmarked defaults for the model, tools, memory, sessions, and context management — ready to take from idea to production. Follow the harness quickstart, or see the Python Strands harness and TypeScript Strands harness packages to get started. Python pip install strands-harness from strands_harness import create_harness agent = create_harness() agent("Find the slowest test in this repo and explain why it's slow") TypeScript npm install @strands-agents/harness import { createHarness } from '@strands-agents/harness' const agent = await createHarness() await agent.invoke("Find the slowest test in this repo and explain why it's slow") Start here to get a batteries-included agent, then drop down to the SDKs below when you want to own the agent loop and wire up tools, model providers, and memory yourself. The harness configuration reference documents every default you can override. The Quickstart Guide covers configuring providers (Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, and more). Working with the SDK The Strands Harness SDK lets you go deeper and control every part of the agent: the loop, tools, model providers, memory, sessions, and hooks. You can dive into the SDK after working with Strands harness or if you prefer building your own harness from the ground up when the assembled defaults aren't enough. Python Requires Python 3.10+: pip install strands-agents strands-agents-tools from strands import Agent from strands_tools import calculator agent = Agent(tools=[calculator]) agent("What is the square root of 1764") The Python SDK README covers tools, model providers, MCP, and bidirectional streaming. TypeScript Requires Node.js 22+: npm install @strands-agents/sdk import { Agent } from '@strands-agents/sdk' const agent = new Agent() const result = await agent.invoke('What is the square root of 1764?') console.log(result) More in the TypeScript SDK README, including Zod-typed tools, structured output, and multi-agent patterns. Documentation For detailed guidance & examples, explore our documentation: User Guide Strands Harness Guide (quickstart · configuration reference) Quick Start Guide Agent Loop Examples API Reference: Python · TypeScript Production & Deployment Guide The docs themselves live in this monorepo under site/, and doc PRs are welcome alongside code changes. Development Git operations (commits, branches, PRs) are done from the repo root. Each package has its own toolchain: Python SDK (strands-py/): cd strands-py pip install hatch hatch test # run unit tests hatch fmt # format & lint TypeScript SDK (strands-ts/): npm ci # install from repo root npm run build # build npm test # run unit tests Documentation site (site/): cd site npm install npm run dev # local dev server at http://localhost:4321/ Contributing ❤️ We welcome contributions! See our Contributing Guide for details on: Reporting bugs & features Development setup Contributing via Pull Requests Code of Conduct Reporting of security issues Stay in touch with the team Come meet the Strands team and other users on Discord License This project is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 - see the LICENSE.APACHE file for details. Security See CONTRIBUTING for more information.

items.title: mvt-project/mvt
items.description: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) helps with conducting forensics of mobile devices in order to find signs of a potential compromise. https://mvt.re Mobile Verification Toolkit Important We recently merged the "v3" branch. This introduced breaking changes. If you relied on mvt output in other scripts They might have broken. More details: https://github.com/mvt-project/mvt/issues/757 Mobile Verification Toolkit (MVT) is a collection of utilities to simplify and automate the process of gathering forensic traces helpful to identify a potential compromise of Android and iOS devices. It has been developed and released by the Amnesty International Security Lab in July 2021 in the context of the Pegasus Project along with a technical forensic methodology. It continues to be maintained by Amnesty International and other contributors. Note MVT is a forensic research tool intended for technologists and investigators. It requires understanding digital forensics and using command-line tools. This is not intended for end-user self-assessment. If you are concerned with the security of your device please seek reputable expert assistance. Indicators of Compromise MVT supports using public indicators of compromise (IOCs) to scan mobile devices for potential traces of targeting or infection by known spyware campaigns. This includes IOCs published by Amnesty International and other research groups. Warning Public indicators of compromise are insufficient to determine that a device is "clean", and not targeted with a particular spyware tool. Reliance on public indicators alone can miss recent forensic traces and give a false sense of security. Reliable and comprehensive digital forensic support and triage requires access to non-public indicators, research and threat intelligence. Such support is available to civil society through Amnesty International's Security Lab or through our forensic partnership with Access Now’s Digital Security Helpline. More information about using indicators of compromise with MVT is available in the documentation. Installation MVT can be installed from sources or from PyPI (you will need some dependencies, check the documentation): pip3 install mvt You can also install MVT from PyPI with uv. First, install uv: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh Then install MVT as a command-line tool: uv tool install mvt For alternative installation options and known issues, please refer to the documentation as well as GitHub Issues. Usage MVT provides three commands: mvt-ios and mvt-android analyse acquisitions from devices of that platform, and mvt hosts what belongs to neither: version, completion, plugins and download-iocs (version and download-iocs remain available on the platform commands for now). Running mvt on its own shows the installed version, update notices and the available commands. Check out the documentation to learn how to use them! Pass --verbose to any of the three commands, before the command name (mvt-ios --verbose check-backup ...), for debug output. The --verbose option the check-* commands accept after their name still works but is kept for compatibility only and will be removed in a future release. Shell completion MVT can generate a shell completion script for Bash, Zsh, and Fish which covers mvt, mvt-ios and mvt-android: mvt completion The command prints setup instructions by default. To generate the completion script directly, pass the shell name: mvt completion bash MVT only writes completion files or shell configuration when --install is passed. See the command completion documentation for details. Plugin packages extend MVT with additional forensic modules, which run inside the check-* commands, and with top-level commands on mvt, mvt-ios and mvt-android. See the development documentation for writing and installing them, and the custom CLI command documentation for the entry points a package registers commands in. License The purpose of MVT is to facilitate the consensual forensic analysis of devices of those who might be targets of sophisticated mobile spyware attacks, especially members of civil society and marginalized communities. We do not want MVT to enable privacy violations of non-consenting individuals. In order to achieve this, MVT is released under its own license. Read more here.

items.title: 「救了174人的生命」：杜拜航空劫機案，遭刺傷的印度機師是誰？
items.description: Embassy of India in Israel / 印度政府赞扬斯米特·马查尔（Smit Machchhar）展现“非凡勇气”。 一架从阿联酋杜拜飞往以色列的客机上，在9月30日发生企图空中劫机事件。其中一名机师刺伤另一名机师后，乘客与机组人员合力制止施袭者，客机改降沙乌地阿拉伯，安全降落。 遭刺伤的机师证实为印度籍机长斯米特·马查尔（Capt Smit Machchhar），他被送往沙乌地阿拉伯西北部城市塔布克（Tabuk）的医院治疗。 印度驻阿拉伯联合大公国大使馆表示，马查尔“健康状况良好，恢复情况理想”。 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）赞扬他是“真正的英雄”，“拯救了174人的生命”，并阻止了一场“灾难性的空中事故”。 印度驻以色列大使迪帕克·米塔尔（Deepak Mittal）表示，他为马查尔的勇气感到骄傲，并很高兴能见到他。 Reuters 多年飞行经验 马查尔在印度孟买长大，他的父母目前仍居住于当地。 2008年，他进入纽西兰但尼丁（Dunedin）的航空学校Mainland Air就读，三年后加入印度航空公司SpiceJet担任商业航空机师。 2022年，他移居杜拜，并以资深机师身分加入杜拜航空。 Mainland Air执行长菲利普·基恩（Philip Kean）向BBC表示，他记得马查尔是一位在危机时刻仍能保持冷静的人。 他说：“我们训练过他如何应对迫降，但不是这种情况，因为这类事件极其罕见。” “虽然已是很久以前，但他给人的印象是一位认真诚实的工作者。” 根据其LinkedIn个人档案，马查尔累积飞行时数超过9,750小时，其中超过6,400小时为机长飞行时数。 他的前东家香料航空（SpiceJet）发表声明，称马查尔为“英雄”，并表示他拯救了“无数生命”。 曾在香料航空与他共事的老友达拉夫·戈萨利亚机长（Capt Dharav Gosalia）形容他外向、而且“非常开朗”。 戈萨利亚表示，绰号“Smit Mac”的马查尔是一位纪律严明的飞行员，接受过多年训练，包括向转任民航飞行员的前印度空军飞行员学习。 Dharav Gosalia / 戈萨利亚（左）与马查尔（右）自20岁起便相识。 “你能安全下飞机，是我最在意的事” 去年，马查尔曾在名为《Bona-Fide Banter》的播客节目中谈及自己如何踏上飞行之路，以及身为飞行员的经历。 他表示，航空业“从来不是童年的梦想”。大约19岁时，他曾就读管理课程，原打算接手家族事业，但后来偶然参加一场航空讲座，“从此爱上飞行”。 马查尔也谈到，当自己穿上飞行员制服时，便会变得非常专注，并把心思“百分之百放在工作上”。 但他补充说，与年轻时相比，他如今更重视工作与生活平衡，以及与家人相处的时间。 他建议说：“给自己私人生活同等的重要性，这会让你飞得更久。” 他也分享自己在飞行途中面对过的挑战，包括一次有乘客提早产子，机组人员通力合作，确保婴儿平安出生。 他说：“从航空的角度来说，我很幸运一路上遇到许多帮助我的人，他们造就了今天的我。” 他并表示，许多资深飞行员教会他如何面对高压情况。 在这段访谈进行时，马查尔表示，他驾驶过的飞机从未需要紧急降落。 不过，他曾遇过机上医疗紧急事件，以及一些导致航班延误的小型飞机故障。 他说：“延误不是我的问题。只要你能安全走下飞机，那就是我最在意的事。” 自马查尔的身分曝光后，印度社群媒体涌现大量赞扬声浪，不少人称他为英雄。 该播客的片段也迅速在网路上疯传。 Getty Images / 马查尔于2022年加入杜拜航空。 飞行途中遭刺伤 杜拜航空航班FZ1073于格林威治时间03:05（当地时间07:05）自阿拉伯联合大公国杜拜国际机场起飞，目的地为以色列本古里安机场。 机上至少载有150人，内塔尼亚胡表示，乘客中“几乎全部”为以色列人。 航班追踪网站Flightradar24数据显示，客机起飞约两个半小时后，在沙乌地阿拉伯上空快速下降，于大约05:21的两分钟内下降超过17,000英尺（5,000公尺）。 数分钟后，客机发出紧急代码7700，随后改发7500代码，后者代表劫机事件。 05:40，这架曾短暂进入约旦领空的飞机折返沙乌地阿拉伯，之后开始人工操作下降准备降落。 不到一小时后，飞机再次发出7700代码。 当地媒体最初引述以色列官员表示，两名机师在机上发生打斗。 但内塔尼亚胡周三于事件后证实，一名机师刺伤另一名机师后，“显然试图使飞机坠毁”。 他表示，一名以色列乘客告诉他，“飞机开始旋转并下降”，随后该名乘客与一名机组人员闯入驾驶舱，制伏了“实施刺伤行为的机师”。 根据位置数据显示，飞机改降至沙乌地阿拉伯西北部塔布克机场，并于06:58落地。 其后，遭刺伤的机师被确认为马查尔。根据印度驻沙乌地阿拉伯大使馆说法，他目前情况稳定。 莫迪与特朗普赞扬马查尔 印度总理莫迪（Narendra Modi）表示，尽管受到重伤，马查尔仍展现出“非凡勇气与坚定决心，保护他人的生命”。 他在社交平台X发文表示：“他的英勇行为帮助挽救数百人的生命，避免了一场重大悲剧。” 他同时祝愿马查尔早日康复。 印度外交部长苏杰生（S Jaishankar）则赞扬马查尔在面对重大危险时展现出“非凡的勇气与卓越的临危不乱”。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）在白宫向记者表示，这名机师“伤势非常严重”，但在遭袭击时仍设法打开驾驶舱门。 他说：“这在某种程度上令人难以置信，他是个英雄，因为他打开了舱门。他成功向后退开，并把门打开了。” 拉奇塔·普拉萨德（Rachita Prasad）与梅莉尔·塞巴斯蒂安（Meryl Sebastian）对本文亦有补充报导。 我们使用了人工智慧协助翻译这篇文章，它的原文是英文。在发布之前，BBC记者检查了翻译的内容。 按此了解我们如何使用人工智慧。
items.content: Embassy of India in Israel / 印度政府赞扬斯米特·马查尔（Smit Machchhar）展现“非凡勇气”。 一架从阿联酋杜拜飞往以色列的客机上，在9月30日发生企图空中劫机事件。其中一名机师刺伤另一名机师后，乘客与机组人员合力制止施袭者，客机改降沙乌地阿拉伯，安全降落。 遭刺伤的机师证实为印度籍机长斯米特·马查尔（Capt Smit Machchhar），他被送往沙乌地阿拉伯西北部城市塔布克（Tabuk）的医院治疗。 印度驻阿拉伯联合大公国大使馆表示，马查尔“健康状况良好，恢复情况理想”。 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）赞扬他是“真正的英雄”，“拯救了174人的生命”，并阻止了一场“灾难性的空中事故”。 印度驻以色列大使迪帕克·米塔尔（Deepak Mittal）表示，他为马查尔的勇气感到骄傲，并很高兴能见到他。 Reuters 多年飞行经验 马查尔在印度孟买长大，他的父母目前仍居住于当地。 2008年，他进入纽西兰但尼丁（Dunedin）的航空学校Mainland Air就读，三年后加入印度航空公司SpiceJet担任商业航空机师。 2022年，他移居杜拜，并以资深机师身分加入杜拜航空。 Mainland Air执行长菲利普·基恩（Philip Kean）向BBC表示，他记得马查尔是一位在危机时刻仍能保持冷静的人。 他说：“我们训练过他如何应对迫降，但不是这种情况，因为这类事件极其罕见。” “虽然已是很久以前，但他给人的印象是一位认真诚实的工作者。” 根据其LinkedIn个人档案，马查尔累积飞行时数超过9,750小时，其中超过6,400小时为机长飞行时数。 他的前东家香料航空（SpiceJet）发表声明，称马查尔为“英雄”，并表示他拯救了“无数生命”。 曾在香料航空与他共事的老友达拉夫·戈萨利亚机长（Capt Dharav Gosalia）形容他外向、而且“非常开朗”。 戈萨利亚表示，绰号“Smit Mac”的马查尔是一位纪律严明的飞行员，接受过多年训练，包括向转任民航飞行员的前印度空军飞行员学习。 Dharav Gosalia / 戈萨利亚（左）与马查尔（右）自20岁起便相识。 “你能安全下飞机，是我最在意的事” 去年，马查尔曾在名为《Bona-Fide Banter》的播客节目中谈及自己如何踏上飞行之路，以及身为飞行员的经历。 他表示，航空业“从来不是童年的梦想”。大约19岁时，他曾就读管理课程，原打算接手家族事业，但后来偶然参加一场航空讲座，“从此爱上飞行”。 马查尔也谈到，当自己穿上飞行员制服时，便会变得非常专注，并把心思“百分之百放在工作上”。 但他补充说，与年轻时相比，他如今更重视工作与生活平衡，以及与家人相处的时间。 他建议说：“给自己私人生活同等的重要性，这会让你飞得更久。” 他也分享自己在飞行途中面对过的挑战，包括一次有乘客提早产子，机组人员通力合作，确保婴儿平安出生。 他说：“从航空的角度来说，我很幸运一路上遇到许多帮助我的人，他们造就了今天的我。” 他并表示，许多资深飞行员教会他如何面对高压情况。 在这段访谈进行时，马查尔表示，他驾驶过的飞机从未需要紧急降落。 不过，他曾遇过机上医疗紧急事件，以及一些导致航班延误的小型飞机故障。 他说：“延误不是我的问题。只要你能安全走下飞机，那就是我最在意的事。” 自马查尔的身分曝光后，印度社群媒体涌现大量赞扬声浪，不少人称他为英雄。 该播客的片段也迅速在网路上疯传。 Getty Images / 马查尔于2022年加入杜拜航空。 飞行途中遭刺伤 杜拜航空航班FZ1073于格林威治时间03:05（当地时间07:05）自阿拉伯联合大公国杜拜国际机场起飞，目的地为以色列本古里安机场。 机上至少载有150人，内塔尼亚胡表示，乘客中“几乎全部”为以色列人。 航班追踪网站Flightradar24数据显示，客机起飞约两个半小时后，在沙乌地阿拉伯上空快速下降，于大约05:21的两分钟内下降超过17,000英尺（5,000公尺）。 数分钟后，客机发出紧急代码7700，随后改发7500代码，后者代表劫机事件。 05:40，这架曾短暂进入约旦领空的飞机折返沙乌地阿拉伯，之后开始人工操作下降准备降落。 不到一小时后，飞机再次发出7700代码。 当地媒体最初引述以色列官员表示，两名机师在机上发生打斗。 但内塔尼亚胡周三于事件后证实，一名机师刺伤另一名机师后，“显然试图使飞机坠毁”。 他表示，一名以色列乘客告诉他，“飞机开始旋转并下降”，随后该名乘客与一名机组人员闯入驾驶舱，制伏了“实施刺伤行为的机师”。 根据位置数据显示，飞机改降至沙乌地阿拉伯西北部塔布克机场，并于06:58落地。 其后，遭刺伤的机师被确认为马查尔。根据印度驻沙乌地阿拉伯大使馆说法，他目前情况稳定。 莫迪与特朗普赞扬马查尔 印度总理莫迪（Narendra Modi）表示，尽管受到重伤，马查尔仍展现出“非凡勇气与坚定决心，保护他人的生命”。 他在社交平台X发文表示：“他的英勇行为帮助挽救数百人的生命，避免了一场重大悲剧。” 他同时祝愿马查尔早日康复。 印度外交部长苏杰生（S items.title: 美國女囚死刑執行失敗：注射兩劑藥物仍存活，接下來將如何發展？
items.description: Reuters / 我们目前所知：克莉丝塔·派克在两次注射致命药物后仍然生还（英文影片） 美国田纳西州一名女囚犯接受死刑，但在两次致命药物注射后仍然存活，目前被送到医院接受治疗且情况危急。 这是当地半年内第二宗死刑执行失败事件，州长比尔·李（Bill Lee）已下令展开第三方调查，并暂停田纳西州今年其余的死刑执行。 这次事件的女囚犯名为克莉丝塔·派克（Christa Pike），是一名被定罪的杀人犯，1996年被判处死刑。 她的死刑执行此前已引发法律攻防，如今又有新的一连串问题。究竟是何处出错？而接下来又会发生什么？ 两剂注射后仍存活，哪里出了问题？ 克莉丝塔·派克（Christa Pike）现年50岁，她因1995年杀害19岁女子柯琳·斯莱默（Colleen Slemmer），于1996年被判处死刑。 她原定于周三（9月30日）晚间在田纳西州接受处决。美国最高法院在行刑前最后一刻批准当局执行注射死刑。 派克被注射两剂戊巴比妥（pentobarbital），但其法律团队表示，两次注射均未能让她心跳停止，甚至仍可听见她打鼾。 US Pool / 影片：目击者讲述克丽丝塔·派克（Christa Pike）死刑执行失败的经过（英文影片） 田纳西州矫正署为其执行方式辩护，称“程序规范不允许在已执行措施之外进一步采取其他程序”。 根据美联社报导，州政府现行规范并未明确说明，如果囚犯在第二剂药物注射后仍然存活，接下来应如何处理。 当局尚未表明是否会再次尝试处决派克，也未解释为何注射剂量最终未造成死亡。 死刑反对者表示，由于派克处决过程有部分是在帷幕后进行，一部分过程未对外公开，因此很难判断究竟发生了什么问题。 国际法律组织Reprieve执行长玛雅·福阿（Maya Foa）表示：“致命注射从头到尾都依赖保密机制，以掩盖国家夺取人类生命的暴力本质。” 接下来会发生什么？ 田纳西州矫正署表示，派克已被送往州外医疗机构。而她其中一名律师周三则表示，她正在医院接受“维持生命措施”。 律师兰迪·斯派维（Randy Spivey）周四向媒体表示：“我们目前还不清楚她的情况，对她的健康状况也没有太多新的资讯。” 埃默里大学医学院（Emory University School of Medicine）医学教授乔尔·齐沃特博士（Dr Joel Zivot）透过电邮向BBC表示：“由于开始急救的时间延迟，她（派克）很有可能已出现脑部损伤。” 长期代理死刑犯案件的律师约翰·米尔斯（John Mills）表示，从历史上看，美国最高法院从未阻止第二次执行死刑的尝试。 2024年，法院允许阿拉巴马州再次处决肯尼斯·尤金·史密斯（Kenneth Eugene Smith），采用实验性的缺氧方式执行；此前两年，当局曾以药物注射处决他但失败。 1947年，美国最高法院的一项判决曾允许路易斯安那州再次将少年威利·法兰西斯（Willie Francis）送上电椅，他17岁时首次处决失败。 法院裁定，第二次执行死刑并不违反宪法禁止一罪二审，或残酷与异常惩罚的规定，而法兰西斯最终于18岁时被处决。 谈到这次派克案时，米尔斯表示：“如果问题是联邦法院是否可能介入阻止第二次执行，我恐怕答案是非常明确的：不会。” 药物“戊巴比妥”是什么？ 戊巴比妥（pentobarbital）是一种强效镇静剂，会减缓身体运作，包括神经系统活动。 医师有时会使用戊巴比妥治疗部分疾病，但在高剂量下，也可作为注射死刑药物致人死亡。 去年，美国联邦政府在拜登（Joe Biden）政府任内进行检讨后，重新引发外界对该药物用于注射死刑的关注。检讨指出，此药可能导致“不必要的痛苦与折磨”。 拜登政府因此禁止联邦层级死刑执行使用该药物，但此禁令不适用于田纳西州等可自行决定执行方式的州政府。 近年来，由于制药公司反对其产品被用于处决用途，各州取得死刑执行药物的难度日益增加。 田纳西州矫正署并未正面回应派克法律团队的说法。派克的律师质疑，执行死刑所使用的戊巴比妥可能已变质，因而影响药效。 过去发生过类似事件吗？ 这不是田纳西州今年首起失败的死刑执行案件。 上一次涉及囚犯东尼·卡拉瑟斯（Tony Carruthers），他因1994年绑架并杀害三人而被定罪，原本今年5月要执行死刑，但被延期，原因是工作人员无法找到适合注射的静脉。他获州长批准暂缓执行一年。 根据死刑资讯中心（Death Penalty Information Center）统计，2022年全美超过三分之一的死刑执行出现失误或严重问题。 Family handout / 柯琳·斯莱默遭派克及其男友虐待并残忍杀害。 谋杀案的死者是谁？ 派克于1995年杀死的柯琳·斯莱默（Colleen Slemmer）是谁？ 两人是在一个“问题青少年”职业训练营中认识的。 斯莱默的遗体胸口被刻上了倒五芒星（Pentagram），这是常与撒旦崇拜团体相关的符号。 派克指控柯琳曾侮辱她，并试图抢走她当时17岁的男友塔达里尔·希普（Tadaryl Shipp）。 营地另外两名住民后来作证称，派克曾吹嘘这起谋杀案，并向他们展示一块柯琳的头骨碎片。 柯琳的母亲梅伊·马蒂内兹（May Martinez）告诉《People》杂志，她和丈夫劳尔·马蒂内兹（Raul Martinez）从佛罗里达州开车11个小时前来观看死刑执行。 “我希望她（派克）记得柯琳是谁，也记得他们对她做过什么，而且无论她去到哪里，都永远不要忘记。”她说。 派克的共同犯案者塔达里尔·希普（Tadaryl Shipp）被判终身监禁，并保有假释可能，目前仍在服刑。 由于犯案时尚未达法定成年年龄，因此他得以免于死刑。 Tennessee Department of Correction / 派克的共同犯案者塔达里尔・希普（Tadaryl Shipp）免于死刑。 我们使用了人工智慧协助翻译这篇文章，它的原文是英文。在发布之前，BBC记者检查了翻译的内容。 2024年，法院允许阿拉巴马州再次处决肯尼斯·尤金·史密斯（Kenneth Eugene Smith），采用实验性的缺氧方式执行；此前两年，当局曾以药物注射处决他但失败。 1947年，美国最高法院的一项判决曾允许路易斯安那州再次将少年威利·法兰西斯（Willie Francis）送上电椅，他17岁时首次处决失败。 法院裁定，第二次执行死刑并不违反宪法禁止一罪二审，或残酷与异常惩罚的规定，而法兰西斯最终于18岁时被处决。 谈到这次派克案时，米尔斯表示：“如果问题是联邦法院是否可能介入阻止第二次执行，我恐怕答案是非常明确的：不会。” 药物“戊巴比妥”是什么？ 戊巴比妥（pentobarbital）是一种强效镇静剂，会减缓身体运作，包括神经系统活动。 医师有时会使用戊巴比妥治疗部分疾病，但在高剂量下，也可作为注射死刑药物致人死亡。 去年，美国联邦政府在拜登（Joe Biden）政府任内进行检讨后，重新引发外界对该药物用于注射死刑的关注。检讨指出，此药可能导致“不必要的痛苦与折磨”。 拜登政府因此禁止联邦层级死刑执行使用该药物，但此禁令不适用于田纳西州等可自行决定执行方式的州政府。 近年来，由于制药公司反对其产品被用于处决用途，各州取得死刑执行药物的难度日益增加。 田纳西州矫正署并未正面回应派克法律团队的说法。派克的律师质疑，执行死刑所使用的戊巴比妥可能已变质，因而影响药效。 过去发生过类似事件吗？ 这不是田纳西州今年首起失败的死刑执行案件。 上一次涉及囚犯东尼·卡拉瑟斯（Tony Carruthers），他因1994年绑架并杀害三人而被定罪，原本今年5月要执行死刑，但被延期，原因是工作人员无法找到适合注射的静脉。他获州长批准暂缓执行一年。 根据死刑资讯中心（Death Penalty Information Center）统计，2022年全美超过三分之一的死刑执行出现失误或严重问题。 Family handout / 柯琳·斯莱默遭派克及其男友虐待并残忍杀害。 谋杀案的死者是谁？ 派克于1995年杀死的柯琳·斯莱默（Colleen Slemmer）是谁？ 两人是在一个“问题青少年”职业训练营中认识的。 斯莱默的遗体胸口被刻上了倒五芒星（Pentagram），这是常与撒旦崇拜团体相关的符号。 派克指控柯琳曾侮辱她，并试图抢走她当时17岁的男友塔达里尔·希普（Tadaryl Shipp）。 营地另外两名住民后来作证称，派克曾吹嘘这起谋杀案，并向他们展示一块柯琳的头骨碎片。 柯琳的母亲梅伊·马蒂内兹（May Martinez）告诉《People》杂志，她和丈夫劳尔·马蒂内兹（Raul Martinez）从佛罗里达州开车11个小时前来观看死刑执行。 “我希望她（派克）记得柯琳是谁，也记得他们对她做过什么，而且无论她去到哪里，都永远不要忘记。”她说。 派克的共同犯案者塔达里尔·希普（Tadaryl Shipp）被判终身监禁，并保有假释可能，目前仍在服刑。 由于犯案时尚未达法定成年年龄，因此他得以免于死刑。 Tennessee Department of Correction / 派克的共同犯案者塔达里尔・希普（Tadaryl Shipp）免于死刑。 我们使用了人工智慧协助翻译这篇文章，它的原文是英文。在发布之前，BBC记者检查了翻译的内容。 按此了解我们如何使用人工智慧。

items.title: 西班牙與中國愈走愈近，歐盟多方為何不滿？
items.description: BBC 在巴塞隆拿的街头，火红与金色相间的中国龙（里面的人想必热得满身大汗）在欢欣的人群中穿梭起舞。来自中国的杂技演员则透过翻滚、抛接和高高掷起球形灯笼，引来阵阵惊叹。仿佛施了魔法一般，灯笼内的蜡烛始终保持直立。 上海本周创下历史，成为首个获邀担任“巴塞隆拿慈悲圣母节”主宾城市的亚洲大都市。这个著名文化节庆以热闹喧腾见称，其大型街头巡游主要用来展现流传数百年的加泰隆尼亚传统。 因此，眼前的景象格外难得：身穿天鹅绒服饰的加泰隆尼亚风笛手，摇曳生姿地走过巴塞隆拿的主要林荫大道。他们奏出的中世纪旋律，与伴随一群群中国表演者而来的悠扬乐声交织在一起。 上海市副市长卢山专程飞往巴塞隆拿，出席“慈悲圣母节”开幕典礼并发表演说。他表示，中国与加泰隆尼亚的文化传统在形式上有所不同，两者却有“相通的精神”。 西班牙与中国正处于一段相互欣赏的时期。然而，这种友好气氛在欧盟内部远非普遍共识。 BBC / 传统中式滚灯表演是拉梅尔塞节开幕典礼的一部分。 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯（Pedro Sanchez）在四年间四度会晤中国国家主席习近平。自特朗普于两年前再次当选以来，他一直敦促欧盟整体改善与中国的关系。 桑切斯的做法引起部分欧洲伙伴不满。这些国家把北京视为战略竞争对手，也认为中国可能对欧盟构成地缘政治威胁。它们私下质疑，马德里向中国企业敞开市场，会否让中国成为欧盟内部的“经济敌人”。 桑切斯并非唯一偏离欧盟既定路线的领导人。全球局势动荡，令不少欧盟国家感到受压和缺乏保障。它们也不确定，在特朗普执政下，美国是否仍然可靠。特朗普的贸易和国防政策被视为难以预测，有时甚至带有攻击性。因此，各成员国开始按照自身需要挑选战略伙伴，即使这会疏远或惹恼其他欧盟国家。 那么，这些新建立的联盟是否有可能导致欧盟，甚至北约的团结出现永久性裂痕？ 西班牙被指追求私利 德国和法国这两个欧盟最具影响力的国家，最近已联手支持对中国采取更强硬的立场。他们希望赋予布鲁塞尔更有力的手段，把获政府补贴的中国竞争者拒于欧盟市场之外，以应对与北京之间不断扩大的贸易失衡。欧盟委员会表示，这一失衡规模已高达惊人的每天10亿欧元（8.5亿英镑）。 其他欧盟国家则忧虑中国与俄罗斯之间的紧密关系。北京否认曾为莫斯科在乌克兰的战争行动提供协助，但国防专家指出，中国提供了技术和经济支持，而他们认为这使俄罗斯得以持续其军事攻势。 正因如此，当西班牙积极拉近与北京的关系时，它被指责是在维护自身利益，而非更广泛的欧洲利益。 专门研究中国与西班牙关系的律师兼学者维克托·科尔蒂索（Victor Cortizo）表示：“这有点像先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题。究竟是西班牙疏远了欧洲盟友，还是他们疏远了我们？” “我认为更多是我们（疏远盟友），是西班牙，但这样做有其正当性。现实政治确实存在。如果我因为更接近中国而吸引中国投资，并提振本国经济，那么这在战略上就比支持那些同样只顾自身利益的盟友更具吸引力。” 我和科尔蒂索交谈时，身边堆满一座座货箱。这里是全球最长货运铁路线的终点。铁路全长逾13,000公里，连接中国东部的义乌与马德里，主要把汽车零件和电器运往西班牙，再将西班牙火腿、红酒等特产运回中国。这条铁路也象征两国关系日益密切。 科尔蒂索告诉我：“我们的首相已决定优先追求国家利益，而非欧盟关系。仅在过去一年，中国对西班牙的投资就增加了一倍。” 中国投资增加 根据西班牙政府贸易与投资机构“西班牙对外贸易发展和投资局”的数据，中国对西班牙的投资正迅速增长，其中尤以新建大型电池工厂和汽车制造厂的投资最为显著。 科尔蒂索认为，随着亲中的维克托·欧尔班（Viktor Orban）不再执政，西班牙可能取代匈牙利，成为北京在欧洲最青睐的投资目的地。在欧尔班执政期间，匈牙利曾被称为“中国进入欧洲的门户”。 科尔蒂索告诉我：“美国投资正在下滑，而中国投资的重要性则日益上升。” 美国仍是西班牙最大的单一外国投资来源国，但根据西班牙经济部数据，净投资额减少了约10亿欧元。 如今，西班牙社会对中国的态度，已远较对其传统盟友美国更为正面。 根据皮尤研究中心今年夏天公布的一项民意调查，54%的西班牙人表示对中国抱持正面看法，而对美国持正面看法的比例为30%。 科尔蒂索表示，与中国做生意相对容易。相比之下，特朗普的关税政策，加上伊朗战争的影响，令与美国做生意困难得多。西班牙民众也看到，特朗普曾威胁对桑切斯实施经济制裁。原因是桑切斯拒绝按特朗普的要求，把国防开支提高至国内生产总值的5%，也不同意让美军使用西班牙境内的基地攻击伊朗。 因此，在许多西班牙人眼中，中国比美国更值得信赖。 而在两年前，当中国大型汽车制造商奇瑞汽车选择西班牙作为其首个欧洲制造和营运枢纽时，令当时已沉寂的西班牙汽车品牌埃夫罗（Ebro）注入了新的生命力。 “中国企业正投资西班牙的汽车制造业，填补我们原有的空缺。”科尔蒂索说。 但批评人士担心，中国企业在西班牙设厂将削弱欧盟单一市场。 在西班牙，并不只有奇瑞一家中国企业。中国电池及固定式储能公司海辰储能计划在西班牙北部纳瓦拉投资，而电池制造商宁德时代参与在萨拉戈萨兴建一座磷酸铁锂电池超级工厂。萨拉戈萨位于巴塞隆拿以西约200英里。 批评人士担心，这些项目是中国企业试图将生产在欧盟本地化，藉此规避针对中国电动车进口所征收的关税。 Reuters / 桑切斯经常与中国国家主席习近平会面。 然而，皇家埃尔卡诺研究所的中国问题专家米格尔·奥特罗（Miguel Otero）批评，西班牙的欧洲盟友态度居高临下且虚伪。 他告诉我：“法国、意大利、德国，它们都各自与中国保持战略关系。西班牙并没有比它们走得更远。我们只是在追赶它们而已。” 他表示，事实上欧洲如今已无法再完全依赖美国，因此西班牙的首要任务是实现多元化。它不仅希望与中国做生意，也希望与加拿大、巴西、印度和非洲发展商业关系。 他说，西班牙并非对中国特别着迷。 不过，安全方面也存在问题。 桑切斯今年4月最近一次访问北京时，会见了中国风力发电机制造商明阳智慧能源的创办人。不久前，该公司在英国高地兴建全英最大风力发电机制造厂的计划，才因国家安全问题遭到否决。 此前，西班牙内政部去年向中国科技巨头华为授予一份价值1,230万欧元的合约，用于储存和管理敏感的司法监听数据，此事在欧盟引发广泛争议。 欧洲议会中来自多个政治团体的议员表示，西班牙的这份合约可能危及整个欧盟。 捷克海盗党（Czech Pirate Party）的议员玛凯塔·格雷戈罗娃（Markéta Gregorová）今年2月表示：“当你引入一家高风险供应商时……我们面对的不仅是局部性的数据泄露风险，更可能破坏欧洲情报共享体系的根基。”她隶属于绿党党团。 Reuters / 华为在西班牙获得一份金额庞大的合约，负责储存和管理敏感的司法监听数据。 西班牙中间偏右在野党成员胡安·伊格纳西奥·索伊多·阿尔瓦雷斯（Juan Ignacio Zoido Álvarez）表示，这项决定使“整个欧盟都面临风险”。 西班牙国防部仍然否认存在风险。不过，美国前驻北约大使朱莉安娜·史密斯（Julianne Smith）警告，事件可能严重削弱欧洲的凝聚力。她也是地缘战略顾问公司Clarion Strategies的共同创办人。 她告诉我：“当欧盟国家设法防范一些人眼中反复无常、不可靠的美国所带来的风险时，它们必须谨慎，不要仓促转向那些可能削弱欧盟集体力量的替代选项。” “其中一些日益密切的关系，可能带来实际回报，例如加拿大与欧盟迅速发展的关系。”她说。 “但另一些关系可能造成相反效果。西班牙决定深化与中国的关系，可能进一步妨碍欧盟以一致声音发言，也会令西班牙以至整个欧洲面对更多安全漏洞。” 更多新兴联盟 西班牙并非唯一与具争议性的伙伴建立联盟的欧盟国家。 芬兰与俄罗斯接壤，拥有长达1,300公里的陆地边界。自莫斯科全面入侵乌克兰以来，这使芬兰感到自身处境脆弱。 芬兰的平民人均枪械持有率，属欧盟内最高的水平。它在欧盟和北约中均拥有规模最大的后备役部队。芬兰甚至在桥梁下预留可放置炸药的爆破孔，以备俄军装甲车辆入境时炸毁桥梁。这是一个相信军事准备是生存所必需的国家。 2022年，芬兰认为人多势众能带来安全保障。赫尔辛基放弃了传统的战略中立政策，迅速加入北约。 不过，如今人们担心，若有成员国遭受攻击，华盛顿可能不会履行北约共同防御条款。 由于不再确信美国在有需要时一定会伸出援手，芬兰已转向以色列采购先进防卫装备，包括“大卫投石索”防空系统及“长钉”反坦克导弹。 芬兰在最近一轮加沙战争最激烈之际，仍然与以色列续签合约。当时，芬兰政府已公开表示，对以色列在巴勒斯坦被占领土的行动有相当保留；不少其他欧盟国家也对以色列在加沙和约旦河西岸的政策与行动深感不安。 欧洲政策分析中心（CEPA）跨大西洋防务与安全项目研究员明娜·阿兰德（Minna Alander）表示：“芬兰存在一种看法，认为我们并不总是有能力维持道德上的优越感。生存是有代价的。” “由于以色列在加沙和约旦河西岸的行动，芬兰民众和反对党确实质疑，是否应该支持该国的国防工业，”她说。“但芬兰政府一直避免参与这场争论，只表示与以色列的交易符合芬兰的需要。” 阿兰德说，归根究柢，她的芬兰同胞抱持的是一种“较少感情用事的心态”。 希腊的转变 希腊也感受到来自一个大得多、又与其毗邻的国家的威胁。政治分析网站MacroPolis共同创办人尼克·马尔库齐斯（Nick Malkoutzis）告诉我，希腊视土耳其为“对其国家安全及主权构成持续且重大威胁”。 过去，美国曾在两国之间担任争端调解者。两国同为北约成员。但北约内部人士表示，在特朗普领导下，美国愈来愈被视为在政治及外交层面缺席，华盛顿的注意力明显放在其他地方。 8月底，希腊与以色列签署了两国历史上规模最大的国防出口协议之一。“阿基里斯之盾”（Achilles Shield）协议为雅典提供来自以色列的技术，旨在保护希腊应对包括无人机、飞机及导弹在内的各类威胁。 希腊社会历来同情巴勒斯坦，不少人也对希腊与以色列愈走愈近持怀疑态度。不过，马尔库齐斯表示，公众和政界对这项“超级协议”的反应，比预期平静。 他说，原因在于希腊社会有一项基本共识：面对土耳其，国家必须加强安全保障，而这项需要凌驾其他考虑。 由于以色列是华盛顿的亲密盟友，希腊希望“购买以色列产品”也有助于维持与美国的良好关系，即使在这个动荡时期亦然。 不过，这是一场微妙的平衡，因为根据马尔库齐斯的说法，希腊和芬兰都非常希望被视为“优秀的欧洲人”，为欧洲整体利益作出贡献。 他表示，欧盟各国纷纷朝不同方向寻找出路，令各方更难就国防及安全议题达成共识及发出一致声音，这与欧盟及北约所宣称希望实现的目标背道而驰。 话虽如此，欧洲国家以较小规模的组合联手追求共同利益并非新鲜事。由英国、德国及法国组成的E3小组最初成立于2003年，旨在协调与伊朗的外交谈判，期望达成核协议。如今，它更像是欧洲三个最大军事及经济强国之间较为灵活的沟通渠道。 北欧及北极地区国家亦有自身的合作框架，以推动区域防务；而由捷克、匈牙利、波兰及斯洛伐克组成的“维谢格拉德四国集团”（Visegrad Four），多年来一直是欧盟圈子内广为人知的压力团体。 然而，北约和欧盟都认为，欧洲大陆正承受二战结束以来前所未有的巨大压力。两大组织的领导人说，欧洲现在必须建立统一阵线。 一个咄咄逼人的俄罗斯正在门外发出威胁性的低吼，背后还有北京支持。与此同时，美国这个昔日最亲密的外部盟友，似乎正被其他优先事项分散注意力。 他们认为，分裂、碎片化以及盛行的“小多边主义”，只会令欧洲的对手拍手叫好。中国和俄罗斯正密切注视着事态发展。 本文主图来源：PA / Nur Photo via Getty images items.content: BBC 在巴塞隆拿的街头，火红与金色相间的中国龙（里面的人想必热得满身大汗）在欢欣的人群中穿梭起舞。来自中国的杂技演员则透过翻滚、抛接和高高掷起球形灯笼，引来阵阵惊叹。仿佛施了魔法一般，灯笼内的蜡烛始终保持直立。 上海本周创下历史，成为首个获邀担任“巴塞隆拿慈悲圣母节”主宾城市的亚洲大都市。这个著名文化节庆以热闹喧腾见称，其大型街头巡游主要用来展现流传数百年的加泰隆尼亚传统。 因此，眼前的景象格外难得：身穿天鹅绒服饰的加泰隆尼亚风笛手，摇曳生姿地走过巴塞隆拿的主要林荫大道。他们奏出的中世纪旋律，与伴随一群群中国表演者而来的悠扬乐声交织在一起。 上海市副市长卢山专程飞往巴塞隆拿，出席“慈悲圣母节”开幕典礼并发表演说。他表示，中国与加泰隆尼亚的文化传统在形式上有所不同，两者却有“相通的精神”。 西班牙与中国正处于一段相互欣赏的时期。然而，这种友好气氛在欧盟内部远非普遍共识。 BBC / 传统中式滚灯表演是拉梅尔塞节开幕典礼的一部分。 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯（Pedro Sanchez）在四年间四度会晤中国国家主席习近平。自特朗普于两年前再次当选以来，他一直敦促欧盟整体改善与中国的关系。 桑切斯的做法引起部分欧洲伙伴不满。这些国家把北京视为战略竞争对手，也认为中国可能对欧盟构成地缘政治威胁。它们私下质疑，马德里向中国企业敞开市场，会否让中国成为欧盟内部的“经济敌人”。 桑切斯并非唯一偏离欧盟既定路线的领导人。全球局势动荡，令不少欧盟国家感到受压和缺乏保障。它们也不确定，在特朗普执政下，美国是否仍然可靠。特朗普的贸易和国防政策被视为难以预测，有时甚至带有攻击性。因此，各成员国开始按照自身需要挑选战略伙伴，即使这会疏远或惹恼其他欧盟国家。 那么，这些新建立的联盟是否有可能导致欧盟，甚至北约的团结出现永久性裂痕？ 西班牙被指追求私利 德国和法国这两个欧盟最具影响力的国家，最近已联手支持对中国采取更强硬的立场。他们希望赋予布鲁塞尔更有力的手段，把获政府补贴的中国竞争者拒于欧盟市场之外，以应对与北京之间不断扩大的贸易失衡。欧盟委员会表示，这一失衡规模已高达惊人的每天10亿欧元（8.5亿英镑）。 其他欧盟国家则忧虑中国与俄罗斯之间的紧密关系。北京否认曾为莫斯科在乌克兰的战争行动提供协助，但国防专家指出，中国提供了技术和经济支持，而他们认为这使俄罗斯得以持续其军事攻势。 正因如此，当西班牙积极拉近与北京的关系时，它被指责是在维护自身利益，而非更广泛的欧洲利益。 专门研究中国与西班牙关系的律师兼学者维克托·科尔蒂索（Victor Cortizo）表示：“这有点像先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题。究竟是西班牙疏远了欧洲盟友，还是他们疏远了我们？” “我认为更多是我们（疏远盟友），是西班牙，但这样做有其正当性。现实政治确实存在。如果我因为更接近中国而吸引中国投资，并提振本国经济，那么这在战略上就比支持那些同样只顾自身利益的盟友更具吸引力。” 我和科尔蒂索交谈时，身边堆满一座座货箱。这里是全球最长货运铁路线的终点。铁路全长逾13,000公里，连接中国东部的义乌与马德里，主要把汽车零件和电器运往西班牙，再将西班牙火腿、红酒等特产运回中国。这条铁路也象征两国关系日益密切。 科尔蒂索告诉我：“我们的首相已决定优先追求国家利益，而非欧盟关系。仅在过去一年，中国对西班牙的投资就增加了一倍。” 中国投资增加 根据西班牙政府贸易与投资机构“西班牙对外贸易发展和投资局”的数据，中国对西班牙的投资正迅速增长，其中尤以新建大型电池工厂和汽车制造厂的投资最为显著。 科尔蒂索认为，随着亲中的维克托·欧尔班（Viktor Orban）不再执政，西班牙可能取代匈牙利，成为北京在欧洲最青睐的投资目的地。在欧尔班执政期间，匈牙利曾被称为“中国进入欧洲的门户”。 科尔蒂索告诉我：“美国投资正在下滑，而中国投资的重要性则日益上升。” 美国仍是西班牙最大的单一外国投资来源国，但根据西班牙经济部数据，净投资额减少了约10亿欧元。 如今，西班牙社会对中国的态度，已远较对其传统盟友美国更为正面。 根据皮尤研究中心今年夏天公布的一项民意调查，54%的西班牙人表示对中国抱持正面看法，而对美国持正面看法的比例为30%。 科尔蒂索表示，与中国做生意相对容易。相比之下，特朗普的关税政策，加上伊朗战争的影响，令与美国做生意困难得多。西班牙民众也看到，特朗普曾威胁对桑切斯实施经济制裁。原因是桑切斯拒绝按特朗普的要求，把国防开支提高至国内生产总值的5%，也不同意让美军使用西班牙境内的基地攻击伊朗。 因此，在许多西班牙人眼中，中国比美国更值得信赖。 而在两年前，当中国大型汽车制造商奇瑞汽车选择西班牙作为其首个欧洲制造和营运枢纽时，令当时已沉寂的西班牙汽车品牌埃夫罗（Ebro）注入了新的生命力。 “中国企业正投资西班牙的汽车制造业，填补我们原有的空缺。”科尔蒂索说。 但批评人士担心，中国企业在西班牙设厂将削弱欧盟单一市场。 在西班牙，并不只有奇瑞一家中国企业。中国电池及固定式储能公司海辰储能计划在西班牙北部纳瓦拉投资，而电池制造商宁德时代参与在萨拉戈萨兴建一座磷酸铁锂电池超级工厂。萨拉戈萨位于巴塞隆拿以西约200英里。 批评人士担心，这些项目是中国企业试图将生产在欧盟本地化，藉此规避针对中国电动车进口所征收的关税。 Reuters / 桑切斯经常与中国国家主席习近平会面。 然而，皇家埃尔卡诺研究所的中国问题专家米格尔·奥特罗（Miguel Otero）批评，西班牙的欧洲盟友态度居高临下且虚伪。 他告诉我：“法国、意大利、德国，它们都各自与中国保持战略关系。西班牙并没有比它们走得更远。我们只是在追赶它们而已。” 他表示，事实上欧洲如今已无法再完全依赖美国，因此西班牙的首要任务是实现多元化。它不仅希望与中国做生意，也希望与加拿大、巴西、印度和非洲发展商业关系。 他说，西班牙并非对中国特别着迷。 不过，安全方面也存在问题。 桑切斯今年4月最近一次访问北京时，会见了中国风力发电机制造商明阳智慧能源的创办人。不久前，该公司在英国高地兴建全英最大风力发电机制造厂的计划，才因国家安全问题遭到否决。 此前，西班牙内政部去年向中国科技巨头华为授予一份价值1,230万欧元的合约，用于储存和管理敏感的司法监听数据，此事在欧盟引发广泛争议。 欧洲议会中来自多个政治团体的议员表示，西班牙的这份合约可能危及整个欧盟。 捷克海盗党（Czech Pirate Party）的议员玛凯塔·格雷戈罗娃（Markéta Gregorová）今年2月表示：“当你引入一家高风险供应商时……我们面对的不仅是局部性的数据泄露风险，更可能破坏欧洲情报共享体系的根基。”她隶属于绿党党团。 Reuters / 华为在西班牙获得一份金额庞大的合约，负责储存和管理敏感的司法监听数据。 西班牙中间偏右在野党成员胡安·伊格纳西奥·索伊多·阿尔瓦雷斯（Juan Ignacio Zoido Álvarez）表示，这项决定使“整个欧盟都面临风险”。 西班牙国防部仍然否认存在风险。不过，美国前驻北约大使朱莉安娜·史密斯（Julianne Smith）警告，事件可能严重削弱欧洲的凝聚力。她也是地缘战略顾问公司Clarion Strategies的共同创办人。 她告诉我：“当欧盟国家设法防范一些人眼中反复无常、不可靠的美国所带来的风险时，它们必须谨慎，不要仓促转向那些可能削弱欧盟集体力量的替代选项。” “其中一些日益密切的关系，可能带来实际回报，例如加拿大与欧盟迅速发展的关系。”她说。 “但另一些关系可能造成相反效果。西班牙决定深化与中国的关系，可能进一步妨碍欧盟以一致声音发言，也会令西班牙以至整个欧洲面对更多安全漏洞。” 更多新兴联盟 西班牙并非唯一与具争议性的伙伴建立联盟的欧盟国家。 芬兰与俄罗斯接壤，拥有长达1,300公里的陆地边界。自莫斯科全面入侵乌克兰以来，这使芬兰感到自身处境脆弱。 芬兰的平民人均枪械持有率，属欧盟内最高的水平。它在欧盟和北约中均拥有规模最大的后备役部队。芬兰甚至在桥梁下预留可放置炸药的爆破孔，以备俄军装甲车辆入境时炸毁桥梁。这是一个相信军事准备是生存所必需的国家。 2022年，芬兰认为人多势众能带来安全保障。赫尔辛基放弃了传统的战略中立政策，迅速加入北约。 不过，如今人们担心，若有成员国遭受攻击，华盛顿可能不会履行北约共同防御条款。 由于不再确信美国在有需要时一定会伸出援手，芬兰已转向以色列采购先进防卫装备，包括“大卫投石索”防空系统及“长钉”反坦克导弹。 芬兰在最近一轮加沙战争最激烈之际，仍然与以色列续签合约。当时，芬兰政府已公开表示，对以色列在巴勒斯坦被占领土的行动有相当保留；不少其他欧盟国家也对以色列在加沙和约旦河西岸的政策与行动深感不安。 欧洲政策分析中心（CEPA）跨大西洋防务与安全项目研究员明娜·阿兰德（Minna Alander）表示：“芬兰存在一种看法，认为我们并不总是有能力维持道德上的优越感。生存是有代价的。” “由于以色列在加沙和约旦河西岸的行动，芬兰民众和反对党确实质疑，是否应该支持该国的国防工业，”她说。“但芬兰政府一直避免参与这场争论，只表示与以色列的交易符合芬兰的需要。” 阿兰德说，归根究柢，她的芬兰同胞抱持的是一种“较少感情用事的心态”。 希腊的转变 items.title: 康乃爾大學輪姦案調查：我們目前知道多少？
items.description: BBC / “我非常震惊”：大学生谈康奈尔大学强暴案调查重启事件（英文影片） 美国康奈尔大学（Cornell University）轮奸案备受关注，纽约州检察官决定重启刑事调查。 事发于2024年，该校一名女学生向大学警方报案，指自己在校内一个兄弟会（fraternity house）遭下药轮奸。 女事主今年9月16日对这所常春藤盟校提起民事诉讼，指康奈尔大学未能保护她，也未对涉案男子作出适当惩处。 这些男子被称为“康奈尔七人组”（Cornell Seven），而该名女子在法庭文件中则以“Jane Doe”（女性无名氏）代称。 康奈尔大学表示，支持将案件提交大陪审团审议，但否认外界指称校方未惩处涉案人员的说法。校方也已同意由独立调查人员审查此案。 以下是目前已知情况。 Getty Images / 观看影片：涉嫌兄弟会集体性侵案的调查为何重新展开？ 她提出哪些指控？ 在一份长达101页的民事诉讼中，该女子指称，2024年10月19日晚上，康奈尔大学Chi Phi兄弟会分会的七名男子，在一宗涉及酒精及氯胺酮（ketamine）的事件中，对她进行了数小时的强奸。 事发时，她是康奈尔大学一名20岁的本科生。 Jane Doe 在诉讼中表示，在据称发生事件期间，她已经醉酒，没有能力作出同意。 她表示，当晚与姐妹会成员饮酒后离开，并“独自跌跌撞撞地”前往位于伊萨卡市（Ithaca）的Chi Phi兄弟会会所，见一名男性朋友。 诉讼提出多项指控，包括性侵犯及殴打、疏忽、违反合约，以及违反《纽约州人权法》。 被告包括大学、兄弟会及姐妹会，以及涉嫌参与事件的男子。 诉讼附上一张据称来自兄弟会群组聊天的截图，其中一名成员以粗俗言语提醒其他成员，Jane Doe可能会与人发生性接触。 她的律师表示，在据称遭侵犯后的数天内，她“受到创伤、感到麻木，无法正常生活，也无法接受自己遭遇的恐怖经历”。她于2024年11月8日向康奈尔大学警方报案。 近数周来，公众愤怒情绪升温，原因是Jane Doe在诉讼中指称，校方给予涉事男子“透过提交文章减轻其行为后果的机会”。 Jane Doe 的律师表示，其中两名涉事者已被开除。他向CBS表示，该女子在据称遭侵犯后已退学。 《康奈尔每日太阳报》（Cornell Daily Sun）编辑委员会于9月21日发表题为“康乃尔不做，我们来做”（Cornell Won't, We Will）的文章，公开诉讼被告姓名，引发社交媒体上的强烈反弹。 Getty Images / 康奈尔大学位于纽约州伊萨卡市，是美国顶尖大学之一。 兄弟会Snapchat及短讯内容是什么？ 康奈尔大学表示，康奈尔大学警察局于2024年11月向检察官提交了一张名为“Chi Phi Actives”的 Snapchat 群组截图作为证据。 群组成员姓名均显示于对话中。根据截图内容，在2024年10月20日凌晨2时前不久，成员们以粗俗语言讨论与 Jane Doe 发生一次“免费”性接触的可能性。 CBS纽约新闻（CBS News New York）也刊登了据称由其中一名被告，与一名看似为提出指控的女子之间所交换的更多简讯内容摘录。 据报，这些讯息是在涉嫌强奸事件发生两天后发出的。 其中一则讯息中，一名男子似乎就“事情的发展方式”表示歉意。 他表示，自己的记忆“有点模糊”，而他与另一名男子都因为当时醉得太厉害，未能在事态失控前“制止事情并把其他人赶出去”，而感到内疚。 在该串短讯中，该名女子回覆称，自己的记忆“也非常模糊”，并表示当时所有人都喝醉了。 她还写道，“那些性方面的事情都不违法”，并表示自己喜欢与他及另一名男子相处。 Jane Doe 还提议两人改天再一起吸食大麻，但不要再有“另外五十亿个男人和氯胺酮（ketamine）”。 Reuters / 康奈尔大学 Chi Phi 兄弟会会所，2026年9月拍摄。 康奈尔大学如何回应？ 该女子表示，她在事件发生两星期后向康奈尔大学警方报案。 不久之后，康奈尔大学就“Chi Phi 兄弟会会所内涉及药物滥用及性暴力的严重且令人极度不安指控”发表公开声明。 校方表示，校园警察部门正展开调查，并已暂停Chi Phi兄弟会当地分会，以及“若干名学生”的活动资格。 康奈尔大学亦表示已展开内部调查，以及根据《第九章法案》（Title IX）进行民权调查。该法例禁止接受联邦政府资助的学校，包括大多数大学，出现基于性别的歧视。 在这宗最新诉讼提出后，校方反驳 Jane Doe 关于大学未有充分调查或惩处涉嫌加害者的指控。 校方在声明中表示，案件已交由一个由“受过培训的教职员组成的小组”审理，并作出“一系列处分，包括开除学籍及停学”。 康奈尔大学没有否认部分涉事人士所受处分包括撰写文章。校方表示：“所有被指控人士中，没有任何涉案人员仅以撰写文章作为唯一处分措施。” 康奈尔周二（9月29日）发表声明称，当校方接获相关报告后，已实施“临时停学及其他限制措施”。 校方亦表示，2024年在校园内发生的事件“当时令人震惊，如今依然如此”，“我们正尽一切努力建立一种绝不容忍性不当行为的文化”。 周三（9月30日），州长霍楚（Hochul）表示，她已与大学校长通话，而对方同意就事件进行“独立的外部调查”。 霍楚在社交平台 X 发文表示：“他们明白这件事的重要性”，并补充说：“这种文化必须停止。”康奈尔大学向BBC证实将进行独立调查。 Chi Phi兄弟会Xi分会已于2024年被关闭，至今仍被禁止在校园内活动。 兄弟会有何回应？ Jane Doe在其民事诉讼中将Chi Phi兄弟会列为其中一名被告，指称她因其行为而遭受身体及情绪伤害。 Chi Phi 兄弟会临时执行总监特雷·罗布（Trey Robb）在一份声明中表示，该组织已将康奈尔大学分会被指控的成员开除。 罗布表示：“我们的纪录确认，在‘Jane Doe’向警方报案仅三天后，该兄弟会的Xi分会投票一致通过将被指控的成员除名。” “该分会亦建议全国兄弟会永久开除他们，而我们的总理事会其后在一次会议上作出了这项决定。” 罗布表示，兄弟会“不会就正在法院审理或调查中的事项发表评论”。 为何案件被重新调查？ 汤普金斯县（Tompkins County）地方检察官周一（9月28日）表示，其办公室将重新展开对这宗涉嫌性侵案的刑事调查。 检察官马修·范豪滕（Matthew Van Houten）表示，一旦确定适当控罪，案件将透过大陪审团以“最客观及最公正的方式”处理。 在美国司法制度中，检察官会召集大陪审团审视证据和证词，并决定是否有足够依据提出刑事控罪。 该检察官表示，在两年前案发时，其办公室认为受害女子向执法部门提供的陈述，未达到提出刑事检控所需的法律门槛。 他表示，在准备将案件提交大陪审团前，已联络Jane Doe及其律师，以取得更多资料。 在声明中，检察官范豪滕概述了Jane Doe在2024年涉嫌遇袭后向康奈尔大学警察部门所作的陈述，并指出其内容与诉讼文件中的指控有所不同。 范豪滕周一在声明中表示：“Jane Doe于2024年11月作出的宣誓陈述，并未指称她是在违反自己意愿下被下药，亦未指称遭集体性侵。” 他表示：“相反，Jane Doe的陈述将其参与吸食毒品及发生性行为描述为自愿、清醒且双方同意的行为。” 康奈尔大学发言人向BBC表示，校方警察部门曾向汤普金斯县地方检察官办公室提交一份“详尽的警方调查报告”。 最新报道披露了Jane Doe 在事件发生后向康奈尔大学警方提供的资料。 CBS纽约新闻取得了一份Jane Doe接受校园警察问话的访谈纪录，该访谈于11月14日开始，即事发三个多星期后。 谈及最初的性接触时，她对警方表示：“当时我对这一切基本上是接受的。” 但该媒体报道，她谈及当晚稍后发生的事情时表示：“我可以百分之一百肯定地说，我遭到了性侵。” ABC News亦取得一份11月15日的警方报告。Jane Doe在报告中的声明表示，当晚其中一次后续接触期间，“由于我当时非常醉，我觉得自己无法作出任何决定”。 她在声明中表示：“对我来说，那感觉像是受到胁迫。此外，我觉得基于我的醉酒程度，他们理应知道我当时醉得有多厉害，因为我说话已经含糊不清。” BBC已联络检察官范豪滕的办公室及Jane Doe的律师。 范豪滕向CBS News表示，他此前从未看过这份校园警察访谈纪录。 他亦于周三向《纽约时报》表示，希望与Jane Doe交谈，“讨论现已存在的新证据”。 范豪滕向《纽约时报》表示，他不认为民事诉讼中的指控，已达到提出刑事检控的法律门槛。 他指出，“这件事的重要性在于，她相信有罪行发生，而我们希望查明真相”。
